aiśānye kumudaṃ kuryānnāgendraṃ sitatandulaiḥ ..
tatastu pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ sopavāsena bhārgava .. 2.50.40 ..
jitendriyeṇa dāntena śiraḥsnātena cāpyatha ..
śuklavastrāvṛtenāpi soṣṇīṣeṇa tathaiva ca .. 41 ..
kāñcanālaṃkṛtenāpi sapavitreṇa bhārgava ..
sarvāsāṃ pūjanaṃ kuryāddevatānāṃ pṛthakpṛthaka .. 42 ..
astrāṇāṃ kuñjarāṇāṃ ca padmādīnāṃ tathaiva ca ..
toraṇe tu niviṣṭānāṃ tārkṣyādīnāṃ pṛthakpṛthak .. 43 ..
sāgarāṇāṃ tu kumbheṣu gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ ..
dhūpairdīpairnamaskārairvāsobhiśca pṛthakpṛthak .. 44 ..
tathā pratisarābhiśca bhūṣaṇaiśca pṛthakpṛthak ..
bhūriṇā ca tathānnena pānaiśca vividhaistathā .. 45 ..
2.10.d:
वायव्ये चाञ्जनं पत्रे माषैः कुर्याद्विचक्षणः ॥
नीलश्च पत्रे कौबेरे शतपुष्पामयो भवेत् ॥ 39 ॥
ऐशान्ये कुमुदं कुर्यान्नागेन्द्रं सिततन्दुलैः ॥
ततस्तु पूजनं कार्यं सोपवासेन भार्गव ॥ 2.50.40 ॥
जितेन्द्रियेण दान्तेन शिरःस्नातेन चाप्यथ ॥
शुक्लवस्त्रावृतेनापि सोष्णीषेण तथैव च ॥ 41 ॥
काञ्चनालंकृतेनापि सपवित्रेण भार्गव ॥
सर्वासां पूजनं कुर्याद्देवतानां पृथक्पृथक ॥ 42 ॥
अस्त्राणां कुञ्जराणां च पद्मादीनां तथैव च ॥
तोरणे तु निविष्टानां तार्क्ष्यादीनां पृथक्पृथक् ॥ 43 ॥
सागराणां तु कुम्भेषु गन्धमाल्यानुलेपनैः ॥
धूपैर्दीपैर्नमस्कारैर्वासोभिश्च पृथक्पृथक् ॥ 44 ॥
तथा प्रतिसराभिश्च भूषणैश्च पृथक्पृथक् ॥
भूरिणा च तथान्नेन पानैश्च विविधैस्तथा ॥ 45 ॥
2.10.m:
In the northwest petal, the discerning man should make Añjana with black gram; / and on Kubera's petal (north), Nīla should be made of dill flowers.
In the northeast, one should make Kumuda, the king of elephants, with white husked rice; / then the worship must be performed by one who is fasting, O descendant of Bhṛgu,
subdued in senses, self-controlled, bathed head to toe, / covered in white garments, and wearing a turban,
adorned with gold, and wearing the sacred grass ring, O descendant of Bhṛgu; / he should perform the worship of all the deities separately,
and likewise of the weapons, the elephants, the lotuses and other [emblems], / and separately of Garuḍa and the others seated on the archway,
and of the oceans in the jars, with perfumes, garlands, and unguents, / with incense, lamps, obeisances, and garments, separately,
and with protective amulets and ornaments, separately, / and with abundant food and various kinds of drinks.

2.10.s:
kulmāṣaparamānnābhyāṃ pūjyāste kṛsareṇa ca ..
bhūdakollopikābhakṣyaiḥ sitayā guḍaphāṇitaiḥ .. 46 ..
māsaudanapayaḥkṣaudradadhipāyasasaktubhiḥ ..
apūpaphalamūlānnarāgakhaṇḍavakairdalaiḥ .. 47 ..
evaṃ sampūjanaṃ kṛttvā śaṅkhavādyaravairdvija ..
gītena ca mahābhāga subhagānartitena ca .. 48 ..
tatastu pūjanaṃ kṛtvā pūjāsthānāttathāpyudak..
āhitāgnikulādagniṃ vedimullikhya bodhayet .. 49 ..
devatānāṃ tu sarvāsāmekaikaṃ tu pṛthakpṛthak ..
caturthyantena nāmnā tu praṇavādyena bhārgava .. 2.50.50 ..
śatamājyena juhayānmahāvyāhṛtayastathā ..
tatastu pūjitā nāgā vahniṃ devagaṇāndvijān..51..
kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ sarve vrajeyuḥ svagṛhāṇi te ..
upadraṣṭre tathā kartre sarvaṃ tatra nivedayet ..52..
bhavenniṣkaṃ ca niṣkaṃ ca dhenudhenuṃ bhuvaṃbhuvam ..
aśvamaśvaṃ tathānyā ca dakṣiṇā śaktito bhavet .. 53 ..
2.10.d:
कुल्माषपरमान्नाभ्यां पूज्यास्ते कृसरेण च ॥
भूदकोल्लोपिकाभक्ष्यैः सितया गुडफाणितैः ॥ 46 ॥
मासौदनपयःक्षौद्रदधिपायससक्तुभिः ॥
अपूपफलमूलान्नरागखण्डवकैर्दलैः ॥ 47 ॥
एवं सम्पूजनं कृत्त्वा शङ्खवाद्यरवैर्द्विज ॥
गीतेन च महाभाग सुभगानर्तितेन च ॥ 48 ॥
ततस्तु पूजनं कृत्वा पूजास्थानात्तथाप्युदक्॥
आहिताग्निकुलादग्निं वेदिमुल्लिख्य बोधयेत् ॥ 49 ॥
देवतानां तु सर्वासामेकैकं तु पृथक्पृथक् ॥
चतुर्थ्यन्तेन नाम्ना तु प्रणवाद्येन भार्गव ॥ 2.50.50 ॥
शतमाज्येन जुहयान्महाव्याहृतयस्तथा ॥
ततस्तु पूजिता नागा वह्निं देवगणान्द्विजान्॥51॥
कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं सर्वे व्रजेयुः स्वगृहाणि ते ॥
उपद्रष्ट्रे तथा कर्त्रे सर्वं तत्र निवेदयेत् ॥52॥
भवेन्निष्कं च निष्कं च धेनुधेनुं भुवंभुवम् ॥
अश्वमश्वं तथान्या च दक्षिणा शक्तितो भवेत् ॥ 53 ॥
2.10.m:
They should be worshipped with kulmāṣa grain and boiled rice with milk, and with kṛsara, / with pastries and ollopikā sweets, with sugar, jaggery, and treacle,
with meat, boiled rice, milk, honey, curds, rice pudding, and roasted barley meal, / with cakes, fruits, roots, foods, spiced drinks, sweetmeats, and leaves.
Having thus performed the worship accompanied by the sounds of conches and instruments, twice-born one, / and by song, O fortunate one, and by auspicious dances,
having performed the worship, then north of the place of worship / one should kindle fire taken from the household of a consecrated fire-keeper, having inscribed an altar.
For all the deities, one by one separately, / using the name ending in the dative case and preceded by the Praṇava, O descendant of Bhṛgu,
one should offer a hundred oblations of clarified butter, and likewise the Great Utterances; / then, having worshipped the elephants, the fire, the hosts of deities, and the twice-born,
and having circumambulated them clockwise, they should all go to their own homes; / one should present everything there to the overseer and to the priest.
A niṣka and a niṣka, a cow and a cow, a plot of land and a plot of land, / a horse and a horse should be given, and other sacrificial fees according to one's capacity;

2.10.s:
na bhavetsā mahādroṇā kathañcidapi kasyacit ..
tathā ca hastibhiṣajā pravṛttena ca bhūriṇā .. 54 ..
2.10.d:
न भवेत्सा महाद्रोणा कथञ्चिदपि कस्यचित् ॥
तथा च हस्तिभिषजा प्रवृत्तेन च भूरिणा ॥ 54 ॥
2.10.m: it should not cause great injury in any way to anyone; / and by the physician of elephants, engaged [for the rite] with abundant [means],

2.10.s:
pūjanīyau tathaivātra sāṃvatsara purohitau ..
hastinyāṃ madamattāyāṃ śāntike'smindvijottama .. 55 ..
2.10.d:
पूजनीयौ तथैवात्र सांवत्सर पुरोहितौ ॥
हस्तिन्यां मदमत्तायां शान्तिकेऽस्मिन्द्विजोत्तम ॥ 55 ॥
2.10.m: the astrologer and the royal priest must likewise be worshipped here; / when a female elephant is intoxicated with rut, in this pacification rite, O best of the twice-born,

2.10.s:
rāṣṭrānnirvāsya tāṃ kuryācchāntimetāṃ dvijottama ..
nāgarājñi mṛte kṛtvā tatraivānyaṃ mataṅgajam .. 56 ..
2.10.d:
राष्ट्रान्निर्वास्य तां कुर्याच्छान्तिमेतां द्विजोत्तम ॥
नागराज्ञि मृते कृत्वा तत्रैवान्यं मतङ्गजम् ॥ 56 ॥
2.10.m: having expelled her from the kingdom, one should perform this pacification rite, O best of the twice-born; / when the royal elephant has died, having placed another elephant right there,

2.10.s:
snātaṃ sarvauṣadhairnāgaṃ sarvagandhaistathaiva ca ..
sarvabījaiśca ratnaiśca sarvatīrthajalaistathā .. 57 ..
2.10.d:
स्नातं सर्वौषधैर्नागं सर्वगन्धैस्तथैव च ॥
सर्वबीजैश्च रत्नैश्च सर्वतीर्थजलैस्तथा ॥ 57 ॥
2.10.m: an elephant bathed with all medicinal herbs, and with all fragrant substances, / and with all seeds, with jewels, and with waters of all holy fords,

2.10.s:
āhatāmbarasaṃvītadarśanaṃ śvetalakṣaṇam ..
kāñcanāpīḍite vādyagītapuṇyāhanisvanaiḥ .. 58 ..
2.10.d:
आहताम्बरसंवीतदर्शनं श्वेतलक्षणम् ॥
काञ्चनापीडिते वाद्यगीतपुण्याहनिस्वनैः ॥ 58 ॥
2.10.m: wrapped in fresh cloth, endowed with white auspicious marks, / crowned with a gold diadem, amid the sounds of instruments, song, and benedictory chants,

2.10.s:
arcitaṃ daivato vahniṃ kṛtaviprapradakṣiṇam ..
kariṇīṃ tu samāruhya vadetkarṇe tu kālavit .. 59 ..
2.10.d:
अर्चितं दैवतो वह्निं कृतविप्रप्रदक्षिणम् ॥
करिणीं तु समारुह्य वदेत्कर्णे तु कालवित् ॥ 59 ॥
2.10.m: worshipped with deity offerings, having circumambulated the fire and the brahmins clockwise, / mounting a female elephant, the knower of time should speak into its ear:

2.10.s:
śrīgajastvatkṛte rājā bhavasvāsya gajāgraṇīḥ ..
gandhamālyāgrabhaktaistvāṃ pūjayiṣyati pārthivaḥ .. 2.50.60 ..
2.10.d:
श्रीगजस्त्वत्कृते राजा भवस्वास्य गजाग्रणीः ॥
गन्धमाल्याग्रभक्तैस्त्वां पूजयिष्यति पार्थिवः ॥ 2.50.60 ॥
2.10.m: ‘You have become the royal elephant on the king's behalf; become the leader of his elephants; / the lord of the earth will honour you with scents, garlands, and the first portions of food;

2.10.s:
lokastadājñayā pūjāṃ kariṣyati tathānagha ..
pālanīyastvayā rājā ghorayuddhe tathāhave .. 61 ..
2.10.d:
लोकस्तदाज्ञया पूजां करिष्यति तथानघ ॥
पालनीयस्त्वया राजा घोरयुद्धे तथाहवे ॥ 61 ॥
2.10.m: the people, by his command, will likewise offer worship [to you], O sinless one; / the king must be protected by you in fierce battle and in war.

2.10.s:
tiryagbhāvaṃ samutsṛjya divyaṃ bhāvamanusmara ..
devāsurāṇāṃ yuddhe ca śrīgajastridaśaiḥ kṛtaḥ .. 62 ..
2.10.d:
तिर्यग्भावं समुत्सृज्य दिव्यं भावमनुस्मर ॥
देवासुराणां युद्धे च श्रीगजस्त्रिदशैः कृतः ॥ 62 ॥
2.10.m: Casting aside your animal nature, remember your divine nature; / in the war between gods and asuras, the royal elephant was created by the thirty [gods].

2.10.s:
airāvaṇasutaḥ śrīmānariṣṭo nāma rāvaṇaḥ ..
śrīgajānāṃ tu tattejaḥ sarvamevātra tiṣṭhati .. 63 ..
2.10.d:
ऐरावणसुतः श्रीमानरिष्टो नाम रावणः ॥
श्रीगजानां तु तत्तेजः सर्वमेवात्र तिष्ठति ॥ 63 ॥
2.10.m: The glorious son of Airāvaṇa, named Ariṣṭarāvaṇa, [arose]; / and all the splendor of royal elephants resides in you here.

2.10.s:
tattejastava nāgendra divyabhāgasamanvitam ..
upatiṣṭhatu bhadraṃ te rakṣa rājānamāhave .. 64 ..
2.10.d:
तत्तेजस्तव नागेन्द्र दिव्यभागसमन्वितम् ॥
उपतिष्ठतु भद्रं ते रक्ष राजानमाहवे ॥ 64 ॥
2.10.m: May that splendor, endowed with a divine share, attend upon you, O king of elephants; / may all be well with you; protect the king in battle!’

2.10.s:
ityevamabhiṣiktvena śubhe'hani narādhipaḥ ..
nityaṃ caivāsya kartavyaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ svastivācanam .. 65 ..
2.10.d:
इत्येवमभिषिक्त्वेन शुभेऽहनि नराधिपः ॥
नित्यं चैवास्य कर्तव्यं ब्राह्मणैः स्वस्तिवाचनम् ॥ 65 ॥
2.10.m: Thus consecrated on an auspicious day, the lord of men / must always have the blessing recited for him by brahmins.

2.10.s:
tasyānugamanaṃ kuryuḥ śastrahastāśca mānavāḥ ..
sitavarṇaśca kartavyo rājñaḥ puṇyāhakarmasu .. 66 ..
2.10.d:
तस्यानुगमनं कुर्युः शस्त्रहस्ताश्च मानवाः ॥
सितवर्णश्च कर्तव्यो राज्ञः पुण्याहकर्मसु ॥ 66 ॥
2.10.m: Men with weapons in hand should form his escort; / and he should be painted white in the king's auspicious rites.

2.10.s:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ gajānāṃ śāntikarmasu ..
nakṣatrāṇi praśastāni tithayaśca tathā śṛṇu .. 67 ..
2.10.d:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं गजानां शान्तिकर्मसु ॥
नक्षत्राणि प्रशस्तानि तिथयश्च तथा शृणु ॥ 67 ॥
2.10.m: All this has been told to you regarding pacification rites for elephants; / now listen to the praised lunar mansions and lunar days:

2.10.s:
caturdaśīṃ caturthīṃ ca navamīṃ ca vivarjayet ..
aṅgārakadine rāma dinaṃ bhāskarajasya ca .. 68 ..
2.10.d:
चतुर्दशीं चतुर्थीं च नवमीं च विवर्जयेत् ॥
अङ्गारकदिने राम दिनं भास्करजस्य च ॥ 68 ॥
2.10.m: one should avoid the fourteenth, the fourth, and the ninth [tithis], / the day of Mars, O Rāma, and the day of the son of the Sun (Saturday).

2.10.s:
ṛkṣāṇi vaiṣṇavaṃ tvāṣṭraṃ śasyate śakradaivatam ..
nakṣatrāṇi muhūrtāśca eta eva mahābala .. 69 ..
2.10.d:
ऋक्षाणि वैष्णवं त्वाष्ट्रं शस्यते शक्रदैवतम् ॥
नक्षत्राणि मुहूर्ताश्च एत एव महाबल ॥ 69 ॥
2.10.m: The constellations sacred to Viṣṇu, Tvaṣṭṛ, and Śakra are commended. / These are the asterisms and the auspicious moments, O mighty one.

2.10.s:
deśakālopasampannaṃ vidhinā ca tathā kṛtam ..
śāntikarma gajendrāṇāṃ sarvabādhāvināśanam .. 2.50.70 ..
2.10.d:
देशकालोपसम्पन्नं विधिना च तथा कृतम् ॥
शान्तिकर्म गजेन्द्राणां सर्वबाधाविनाशनम् ॥ 2.50.70 ॥
2.10.m: Performed in accordance with place, time, and rules, / this rite of pacification for lordly elephants destroys all afflictions;

2.10.s:
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ rājñāṃ ca vijayāvaham ..
bhārgavaścyavanaḥ kruddho yathā śakrasya bhārgava .. 71 ..
2.10.d:
धन्यं यशस्यमायुष्यं राज्ञां च विजयावहम् ॥
भार्गवश्च्यवनः क्रुद्धो यथा शक्रस्य भार्गव ॥ 71 ॥
2.10.m: it brings fortune, renown, longevity, and victory to kings. / Just as the descendant of Bhṛgu, Cyavana, when enraged against Śakra, O Bhārgava,

2.10.s:
mado nāma samutpannastathā daityaḥ sudāruṇaḥ ..
indranāśāya śakrārthī tataḥ paścātprasāditaḥ .. 72 ..
2.10.d:
मदो नाम समुत्पन्नस्तथा दैत्यः सुदारुणः ॥
इन्द्रनाशाय शक्रार्थी ततः पश्चात्प्रसादितः ॥ 72 ॥
2.10.m: produced a most dreadful demon named Mada / to slay Indra, desiring [to subdue] Śakra, and was thereafter propitiated;

2.10.s:
madaṃ sa bahudhā cakre prajāpatisamo dvija ..
strīṣvakṣeṣu tathā pāne mṛgayāyāṃ dhane tathā .. 73 ..
2.10.d:
मदं स बहुधा चक्रे प्रजापतिसमो द्विज ॥
स्त्रीष्वक्षेषु तथा पाने मृगयायां धने तथा ॥ 73 ॥
2.10.m: that twice-born sage, equal to Prajāpati, divided Mada into many parts: / in women, in dice, in drinking, in hunting, in wealth,

2.10.s:
vidyāsu caiva sarvāsu sarvaśilpeṣu cāpyatha ..
jīveṣu rāma sarveṣu tathā rūpe bale kule .. 74 ..
2.10.d:
विद्यासु चैव सर्वासु सर्वशिल्पेषु चाप्यथ ॥
जीवेषु राम सर्वेषु तथा रूपे बले कुले ॥ 74 ॥
2.10.m: and in all branches of learning, and in all crafts, / in all living beings, O Rāma, as well as in beauty, strength, and noble birth;

2.10.s:
eko'sya dhāraṇe śakto na kaściditicintayan ..
yathokteṣvadhikaṃ bhāgaṃ kiñcitpāne niveśayet .. 75 ..
2.10.d:
एकोऽस्य धारणे शक्तो न कश्चिदितिचिन्तयन् ॥
यथोक्तेष्वधिकं भागं किञ्चित्पाने निवेशयेत् ॥ 75 ॥
2.10.m: reflecting that no single being would be capable of bearing it, / he placed a larger portion in liquor among those mentioned,

2.10.s:
prāṇināmatha sarveṣāṃ nāgeṣvabhyadhikaṃ tathā ..
mado yadā samabhyeti nāgaṃ brāhmaṇasattama .. 76 ..
2.10.d:
प्राणिनामथ सर्वेषां नागेष्वभ्यधिकं तथा ॥
मदो यदा समभ्येति नागं ब्राह्मणसत्तम ॥ 76 ॥
2.10.m: and similarly an even greater portion among elephants of all living creatures. / When rut comes upon an elephant, O best of brahmins,

2.10.s:
rāma śāntistadā kāryā yādṛśī tāṃ nibodha me ..
śālāprāguttare bhāge sthaṇḍilaṃ kalpayedbudhaḥ .. 77 ..
2.10.d:
राम शान्तिस्तदा कार्या यादृशी तां निबोध मे ॥
शालाप्रागुत्तरे भागे स्थण्डिलं कल्पयेद्बुधः ॥ 77 ॥
2.10.m: the pacification that should then be performed, O Rāma, learn that from me: / In the north-eastern part of the stall, the wise man should prepare an altar.

2.10.s:
sthaṇḍile kamalaṃ kṛtvā dikpatreṣu tatheśvarān ..
kesaraṃ cyavanaṃ nāgānbhuvaṃ kaṃ ca sarasvatīm .. 78 ..
2.10.d:
स्थण्डिले कमलं कृत्वा दिक्पत्रेषु तथेश्वरान् ॥
केसरं च्यवनं नागान्भुवं कं च सरस्वतीम् ॥ 78 ॥
2.10.m: Having made a lotus upon the altar, [he should worship] the lords of the directions on the petals, / Cyavana on the filaments, the elephants, the earth, Brahmā, and Sarasvatī.

2.10.s:
pūjayeḍḍiṇḍimaṃ madhye gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ ..
dhūpadīpanamaskārairvāsobhiśca pṛthakpṛthak .. 79 ..
2.10.d:
पूजयेड्डिण्डिमं मध्ये गन्धमाल्यानुलेपनैः ॥
धूपदीपनमस्कारैर्वासोभिश्च पृथक्पृथक् ॥ 79 ॥
2.10.m: In the center, he should worship the ḍiṇḍima drum with perfumes, garlands, and unguents, / with incense, lamps, obeisance, and garments, each separately.

2.10.s:
sarvāsāṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā pādyādyanurato dvija ..
devatānāṃ ghṛtaṃ hutvā yathāśraddhamaninditam.. 2.50.80
2.10.d:
सर्वासां पूजनं कृत्वा पाद्याद्यनुरतो द्विज ॥
देवतानां घृतं हुत्वा यथाश्रद्धमनिन्दितम्॥ 2.50.80
2.10.m: Having offered worship to all [the deities] with water for feet and the rest, devoted [to the rite], the twice-born / should offer oblations of ghee to the deities according to his faith, blamelessly.

2.10.s:
rasapūrṇo ghaṭo deyo dakṣiṇārthe ca kāñcanam ..
dattvā vāsāṃsi nāgasya gajādhyakṣaṃ ca pūjayet .. 81 ..
2.10.d:
रसपूर्णो घटो देयो दक्षिणार्थे च काञ्चनम् ॥
दत्त्वा वासांसि नागस्य गजाध्यक्षं च पूजयेत् ॥ 81 ॥
2.10.m: A jar filled with sweet liquids should be given, and gold for the sacrificial fee. / Having given garments to the elephant, he should also honour the superintendent of elephants,

2.10.s:
hastipaṃ karmiṇaścānyāndakṣiṇābhirdvijottamān ..
sāṃvatsare ca vittena yataḥ sāṃvatsaraḥ svayam..82..
2.10.d:
हस्तिपं कर्मिणश्चान्यान्दक्षिणाभिर्द्विजोत्तमान् ॥
सांवत्सरे च वित्तेन यतः सांवत्सरः स्वयम्॥82॥
2.10.m: the mahout, other workers, and the best of twice-borns with sacrificial fees, / and [he should honour] the astrologer with wealth, since the astrologer is himself [an embodiment of time].

2.10.s:
gajādhyakṣāya taṃ dadyāddiṇḍimaṃ prayataḥ svayam..
prāṅmukhaśca gajādhyakṣo vādayettaṃ yathāvidhi .. 83 ..
2.10.d:
गजाध्यक्षाय तं दद्याद्दिण्डिमं प्रयतः स्वयम्॥
प्राङ्मुखश्च गजाध्यक्षो वादयेत्तं यथाविधि ॥ 83 ॥
2.10.m: Controlled in mind, he should personally hand over that ḍiṇḍima drum to the superintendent of elephants; / and facing east, the superintendent of elephants should beat it according to rule.

2.10.s:
uccairgambhīranirghoṣe ḍiṇḍime tu śubhaṃ vadet ..
antarā pātite tasmim̐stathaivāpyaśubhaṃ vadet .. 84 ..
2.10.d:
उच्चैर्गम्भीरनिर्घोषे डिण्डिमे तु शुभं वदेत् ॥
अन्तरा पातिते तस्मिम्̐स्तथैवाप्यशुभं वदेत् ॥ 84 ॥
2.10.m: If the ḍiṇḍima drum gives a loud and deep resonance, one should declare it auspicious; / but if it is dropped in the middle, one should declare it inauspicious.

2.10.s:
ḍiṇḍime samyagādatte śubhameva vinirdiśet ..
tadā prabhṛti mattasya tadā nāgasya vai nṛpa .. 85 ..
2.10.d:
डिण्डिमे सम्यगादत्ते शुभमेव विनिर्दिशेत् ॥
तदा प्रभृति मत्तस्य तदा नागस्य वै नृप ॥ 85 ॥
2.10.m: If the ḍiṇḍima drum is taken up properly, one should point out that it is entirely auspicious. / From that time on, of that elephant in rut, O king,

2.10.s:
aśubhe lakṣaṇe jāte bhūyastatkarma cācaret ..
śubhe tu lakṣaṇe jāte gajādhyakṣasya ḍiṇḍimam .. 86..
2.10.d:
अशुभे लक्षणे जाते भूयस्तत्कर्म चाचरेत् ॥
शुभे तु लक्षणे जाते गजाध्यक्षस्य डिण्डिमम् ॥ 86॥
2.10.m: if an inauspicious sign occurs, one should perform that rite again; / but if an auspicious sign occurs, [he should place] the ḍiṇḍima of the elephant superintendent

2.10.s: jaye saṃsthāpya nandādyāgrajapāya..........................sarvabādhāvināśanam .. 87 ..
2.10.d: जये संस्थाप्य नन्दाद्याग्रजपाय॥॥॥॥॥॥॥॥॥॥॥॥॥सर्वबाधाविनाशनम् ॥ 87 ॥
2.10.m: upon the victory [stand] … which destroys all afflictions.

2.10.s:
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kāmyaṃ karma tavānagha ..
upoṣitastathā yāmye yajamāne purohitaḥ .. 88 ..
2.10.d:
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि काम्यं कर्म तवानघ ॥
उपोषितस्तथा याम्ये यजमाने पुरोहितः ॥ 88 ॥
2.10.m: Henceforth I shall declare to you the optional rite, O sinless one: / The patron having fasted when the moon is in the southern constellation (Bharaṇī), the royal priest

2.10.s:
śubhapradamidaṃ snānaṃ yajamānasya kārayet ..
nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthamadhukodakasaṃyutaiḥ .. 89 ..
2.10.d:
शुभप्रदमिदं स्नानं यजमानस्य कारयेत् ॥
न्यग्रोधोदुम्बराश्वत्थमधुकोदकसंयुतैः ॥ 89 ॥
2.10.m: should arrange this bath that bestows fortune for the patron, / with jars containing water infused with nyagrodha, udumbara, aśvattha, and madhūka,

2.10.s:
akālamūlaiḥ kalaśaiḥ pañcabhirgajalakṣaṇaiḥ ..
snātaḥ śuklāmbaro viṣṇuṃ candrārkau varuṇaṃ tathā .. 2.50.90 ..
2.10.d:
अकालमूलैः कलशैः पञ्चभिर्गजलक्षणैः ॥
स्नातः शुक्लाम्बरो विष्णुं चन्द्रार्कौ वरुणं तथा ॥ 2.50.90 ॥
2.10.m: and freshly gathered roots, five [jars] marked with an elephant figure. / Bathed, clad in white garments, he should worship Viṣṇu, the moon and sun, Varuṇa,

2.10.s:
hastinaṃ pūjayedvidvāngandhamālyānnasampadā ..
dhūpadīpanamaskārairvāsobhiśca tathaiva ca .. 91 ..
2.10.d:
हस्तिनं पूजयेद्विद्वान्गन्धमाल्यान्नसम्पदा ॥
धूपदीपनमस्कारैर्वासोभिश्च तथैव च ॥ 91 ॥
2.10.m: and the elephant, the learned man [worshipping] with an abundance of perfumes, garlands, and food, / and likewise with incense, lamps, obeisance, and garments.

2.10.s:
hastidantena sūryāya dattvā dhūpamataḥ param ..
caturthyantena vai nāmnā praṇavādyena bhārgava ..
sahasraśo gajāścātra dakṣiṇā kāñcanaṃ tathā .. 92 ..
2.10.d:
हस्तिदन्तेन सूर्याय दत्त्वा धूपमतः परम् ॥
चतुर्थ्यन्तेन वै नाम्ना प्रणवाद्येन भार्गव ॥
सहस्रशो गजाश्चात्र दक्षिणा काञ्चनं तथा ॥ 92 ॥
2.10.m: Then having offered incense with elephant tusk to the sun, / using its name ending in the dative case and preceded by Om, O Bhārgava, / here thousands of elephants and gold are the sacrificial fee.

2.10.s:
yaḥ svāsate snānamidaṃ prakurvangajendramukhyāngirisannikāśān ..
bahūnavāpnoti tathāsya nāgā bhavantyarogā vinimuktadoṣāḥ ..93 ..
2.10.d:
यः स्वासते स्नानमिदं प्रकुर्वन्गजेन्द्रमुख्यान्गिरिसन्निकाशान् ॥
बहूनवाप्नोति तथास्य नागा भवन्त्यरोगा विनिमुक्तदोषाः ॥93 ॥
2.10.m: Whoever, remaining at ease, performs this bath obtains many / foremost lordly elephants resembling mountains; and his elephants become healthy and freed from afflictions.

2.11.s:
2.51
puṣkara uvāca ..
durgamāyudhasaṃghātaṃ kuñjarāsturagāstathā ..
puruṣaiśca vinā rāma sarvametadapārthakam .. 1 ..
2.11.d:
2.51
पुष्कर उवाच ॥
दुर्गमायुधसंघातं कुञ्जरास्तुरगास्तथा ॥
पुरुषैश्च विना राम सर्वमेतदपार्थकम् ॥ 1 ॥
2.11.m:
2.51
Puṣkara said:
A fortress, a multitude of weapons, and elephants and horses— / all this is useless, O Rāma, without men.

2.11.s:
tasmātprayatnaṃ kurvīta puruṣāṇāṃ samarjane ..
teṣāṃ caivāntarajñāne mūlametadyataḥ śriyaḥ ..2..
2.11.d:
तस्मात्प्रयत्नं कुर्वीत पुरुषाणां समर्जने ॥
तेषां चैवान्तरज्ञाने मूलमेतद्यतः श्रियः ॥2॥
2.11.m: Therefore, one should make an effort in winning men / and in knowing their inner thoughts, since this is the root of royal fortune.

2.11.s:
susahāyārthasampanna balaṃ yasya mahīpateḥ ..
saṃgrāme tumule rāma nūnaṃ tasya jayo bhavet .. 3 ..
2.11.d:
सुसहायार्थसम्पन्न बलं यस्य महीपतेः ॥
संग्रामे तुमुले राम नूनं तस्य जयो भवेत् ॥ 3 ॥
2.11.m: The king whose army is endowed with good allies and wealth, / his victory, O Rāma, is certain in tumultuous battle.

2.11.s:
sakṛdyena kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tasya rājā na viśvaset ..
pāpaṃ tu sukaraṃ tasya sukṛtaścāsya duṣkaram .. 4 ..
2.11.d:
सकृद्येन कृतं पापं तस्य राजा न विश्वसेत् ॥
पापं तु सुकरं तस्य सुकृतश्चास्य दुष्करम् ॥ 4 ॥
2.11.m: The king should not trust him by whom a sin has been committed once; / for him, evil is easy to do, while virtuous action is difficult for him.

2.11.s:
yathā hi malinairvastrairyatra tatropaviśyate ..
tathā calitavṛttastu vṛttaśeṣaṃ na rakṣati.. 5 ..
2.11.d:
यथा हि मलिनैर्वस्त्रैर्यत्र तत्रोपविश्यते ॥
तथा चलितवृत्तस्तु वृत्तशेषं न रक्षति॥ 5 ॥
2.11.m: For just as one sits down anywhere with soiled clothes, / so one who has deviated from conduct does not protect the rest of his conduct.

2.11.s:
rājā na veśayetkārye jano yo nāstiko bhavet ..
āstikā api tatsaṅgātprāpnuyuḥ saṃśayaṃ dvija .. 6 ..
2.11.d:
राजा न वेशयेत्कार्ये जनो यो नास्तिको भवेत् ॥
आस्तिका अपि तत्सङ्गात्प्राप्नुयुः संशयं द्विज ॥ 6 ॥
2.11.m: The king should not appoint to an undertaking a person who is an atheist; / even the faithful might fall into doubt through association with him, O twice-born.

2.11.s:
anāhāryaprabhasyāpi trailokyodbhāsitātmanaḥ ..
kṛṣṇatā rāhusaṃsargātkinna sūryasya vā bhavet ..7..
2.11.d:
अनाहार्यप्रभस्यापि त्रैलोक्योद्भासितात्मनः ॥
कृष्णता राहुसंसर्गात्किन्न सूर्यस्य वा भवेत् ॥7॥
2.11.m: Does not even the sun, whose radiance is irresistible and whose nature illuminates the three worlds, / acquire blackness from contact with Rāhu?

2.11.s:
akāryamityakāryāṇi kuryātkāryavaśena yaḥ ..
vicikitsurdhruvaṃ rāma paścādapi nivartate .. 8 ..
2.11.d:
अकार्यमित्यकार्याणि कुर्यात्कार्यवशेन यः ॥
विचिकित्सुर्ध्रुवं राम पश्चादपि निवर्तते ॥ 8 ॥
2.11.m: He who might do improper deeds under the sway of necessity, thinking 'this is improper,' / doubtful, O Rāma, surely turns back later.

2.11.s:
kāryaṃ buddhvā tvakāryāṇi yaḥ karoti narādhamaḥ ..
akāryakaraṇe śraddhā tasya bhūyobhivardhate .. 9 ..
2.11.d:
कार्यं बुद्ध्वा त्वकार्याणि यः करोति नराधमः ॥
अकार्यकरणे श्रद्धा तस्य भूयोभिवर्धते ॥ 9 ॥
2.11.m: However, that vilest of men who, knowing them to be proper, does improper deeds, / his fondness for doing what is improper increases all the more.

2.11.s:
lokaḥ sarvo mahābhāga paralokanibandhanaḥ ..
nirapekṣasya tatrānyā kā gatiḥ syānnibandhane .. 2.51.10 ..
2.11.d:
लोकः सर्वो महाभाग परलोकनिबन्धनः ॥
निरपेक्षस्य तत्रान्या का गतिः स्यान्निबन्धने ॥ 2.51.10 ॥
2.11.m: The whole world, O fortunate one, is bound to the other world; / for one who is indifferent to that, what other restraint could there be?

2.11.s:
mahāpātakino ye'pi tebhyo'pi ca mahattaraḥ ..
pāpakṛnnāstiko lokastasmāttaṃ parivarjayet .. 11 ..
2.11.d:
महापातकिनो येऽपि तेभ्योऽपि च महत्तरः ॥
पापकृन्नास्तिको लोकस्तस्मात्तं परिवर्जयेत् ॥ 11 ॥
2.11.m: An atheist who does evil is worse even than those / who have committed major sins; therefore, one should avoid him.

2.11.s:
āstikānāṃ ca sādhūnāṃ saṃgrahaḥ śasyate sadā ..
te sahāyā narendrāṇāṃ tathā ye rāma paṇḍitāḥ .. 12 ..
2.11.d:
आस्तिकानां च साधूनां संग्रहः शस्यते सदा ॥
ते सहाया नरेन्द्राणां तथा ये राम पण्डिताः ॥ 12 ॥
2.11.m: And the gathering of the faithful and the virtuous is always commended; / they are the allies of kings, as are those who are learned, O Rāma.

2.11.s:
na paṇḍito mato rāma bahupustakadhāraṇāt ..
paralokabhayaṃ yasya tamāhuḥ paṇḍitaṃ budhāḥ .. 13 ..
2.11.d:
न पण्डितो मतो राम बहुपुस्तकधारणात् ॥
परलोकभयं यस्य तमाहुः पण्डितं बुधाः ॥ 13 ॥
2.11.m: One is not considered learned, O Rāma, on account of possessing many books; / him who fears the other world, the wise call learned.

2.11.s:
agnihotraphalā vedā dattabhuktaphalaṃ dhanam ..
ratiputraphalā dārāḥ śīlavṛttaphalaṃ śrutam .. 14 ..
2.11.d:
अग्निहोत्रफला वेदा दत्तभुक्तफलं धनम् ॥
रतिपुत्रफला दाराः शीलवृत्तफलं श्रुतम् ॥ 14 ॥
2.11.m: The Vedas have the agnihotra as their fruit; wealth has giving and enjoyment as its fruit; / a wife has pleasure and sons as her fruit; learning has virtuous character and conduct as its fruit.

2.11.s:
śīlopapanno nṛpatiḥ sahāyaiḥ śaraistathālpairapi samprayuktaḥ ..
prabhūtanāgāśvabalotkaṭānāṃ karotyarīṇāṃ kadanaṃ raṇeṣu .. 15 .. ..
2.52
.. puṣkara uvāca .. ..
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi narāṇāṃ te cikitsitam ..
tatrāpyādau tathā strīṇāṃ yanmūlaṃ prajanaṃ yataḥ .. 1 ..
mahājambūdvayaṃ rodhraṃ madhukaṃ madhu śarkarā ..
taṇḍulodakasaṃyuktaṃ śoṇitapradare pibet .. 2 ..
ūrdhvaṃ saṃvatsarānnārīṃ raktagulme virecayet ..
snigdhasvinnaśarīrāñca rāma tīkṣṇaurvirecanaiḥ .. 3 ..
jvareṇa ca palāśasya saṃsiddhaṃ yāvakaṃ pibet ..
agnisandhukṣaṇaṃ cānyāstathā kāryaṃ prayatnataḥ .. 4 ..
prasthaṃ vṛṣakamūlasya tailaṃ prasthaṃ vipācayet ..
yonīnāṃ parikopeṣu vedanāmapakarṣati ..5 ..
saurāṣṭrī rocanā rodhraṃ madhūkaṃ triphalā madhu ..
bhadramustāni cūrṇāni vājīkaraṇamuttam .. 6 ..
2.11.d:
शीलोपपन्नो नृपतिः सहायैः शरैस्तथाल्पैरपि सम्प्रयुक्तः ॥
प्रभूतनागाश्वबलोत्कटानां करोत्यरीणां कदनं रणेषु ॥ 15 ॥ ॥
2.52
॥ पुष्कर उवाच ॥ ॥
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि नराणां ते चिकित्सितम् ॥
तत्राप्यादौ तथा स्त्रीणां यन्मूलं प्रजनं यतः ॥ 1 ॥
महाजम्बूद्वयं रोध्रं मधुकं मधु शर्करा ॥
तण्डुलोदकसंयुक्तं शोणितप्रदरे पिबेत् ॥ 2 ॥
ऊर्ध्वं संवत्सरान्नारीं रक्तगुल्मे विरेचयेत् ॥
स्निग्धस्विन्नशरीराञ्च राम तीक्ष्णौर्विरेचनैः ॥ 3 ॥
ज्वरेण च पलाशस्य संसिद्धं यावकं पिबेत् ॥
अग्निसन्धुक्षणं चान्यास्तथा कार्यं प्रयत्नतः ॥ 4 ॥
प्रस्थं वृषकमूलस्य तैलं प्रस्थं विपाचयेत् ॥
योनीनां परिकोपेषु वेदनामपकर्षति ॥5 ॥
सौराष्ट्री रोचना रोध्रं मधूकं त्रिफला मधु ॥
भद्रमुस्तानि चूर्णानि वाजीकरणमुत्तम् ॥ 6 ॥
2.11.m:
Endowed with good character, a king, though employing few allies and arrows, / effects the slaughter of enemies arrogant with their vast force of elephants and horses in battles.
Puṣkara said:
Henceforth I shall describe to you the medical treatment of men;
and even of those, first that of women, since reproduction is rooted in them.
One should drink both large jambu varieties, rodhra, madhuka, honey, and sugar,
mixed with rice-water, for menorrhagia.
After a year, one should purge a woman suffering from a blood tumor (raktagulma),
when her body has been lubricated and sweated, O Rāma, with sharp purgatives.
And in fever she should drink barley-gruel prepared with palāśa;
and for others, kindling of the digestive fire must likewise be performed with effort.
One should cook a prastha of oil with a prastha of vṛṣaka root;
it removes pain in disorders of the vaginal tract.
Saurāṣṭrī, rocanā, rodhra, madhūka, triphalā, honey,
and powders of bhadramustā are an excellent aphrodisiac.

2.11.s:
aśvagandhāvipakvena varāhasya tu medasā ..
granthīkaraṇamabhyaṅgaṃ yoṣitāṃ parikīrtitam .. 7 ..
ekamāmalakaṃ kāle salilāṃjalinā pibet ..
sṛṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇāyase bhāṇḍe tena śātodarī bhavet .. 8 ..
triphalāṃ citrakaṃ śuṇṭhīṃ madhunā tu lihetsadā ..
sthūlānāṃ varanārīṇāṃ kṛṣīkaraṇamuttamam .. 9 ..
aśvagandhāṃ payasyāṃ ca saṃsṛjya payasā pibet ..
māsametatprayuñjānā kṛśā bhavati māṃsalā .. 2.52.10 ..
varāhavasayā kāryamaśvagandhāvipakvayā ..
stanānāṃ mardanaṃ tena nārī pīnastanī bhavet .. 11 ..
mūlakasya cyutaṃ bījaṃ tathaiva tagarasya ca ..
saptarātraṃ tu gomūtre sidhmanāśanamuttamam .. 12 ..
kṣāreṇa hastipiṇḍasya avalgujarasena ca ..
etena prokṣitaṃ śvitraṃ trirātreṇa vinaśyati .. 13 ..
guñjāyāḥ saphalaṃ mūlaṃ citrakaṃ tagaraṃ tathā ..
bhallātakānāṃ ca phalaṃ mūlaṃ caivāśvamārakam .. 14 ..
2.11.d:
अश्वगन्धाविपक्वेन वराहस्य तु मेदसा ॥
ग्रन्थीकरणमभ्यङ्गं योषितां परिकीर्तितम् ॥ 7 ॥
एकमामलकं काले सलिलांजलिना पिबेत् ॥
सृष्टं कृष्णायसे भाण्डे तेन शातोदरी भवेत् ॥ 8 ॥
त्रिफलां चित्रकं शुण्ठीं मधुना तु लिहेत्सदा ॥
स्थूलानां वरनारीणां कृषीकरणमुत्तमम् ॥ 9 ॥
अश्वगन्धां पयस्यां च संसृज्य पयसा पिबेत् ॥
मासमेतत्प्रयुञ्जाना कृशा भवति मांसला ॥ 2.52.10 ॥
वराहवसया कार्यमश्वगन्धाविपक्वया ॥
स्तनानां मर्दनं तेन नारी पीनस्तनी भवेत् ॥ 11 ॥
मूलकस्य च्युतं बीजं तथैव तगरस्य च ॥
सप्तरात्रं तु गोमूत्रे सिध्मनाशनमुत्तमम् ॥ 12 ॥
क्षारेण हस्तिपिण्डस्य अवल्गुजरसेन च ॥
एतेन प्रोक्षितं श्वित्रं त्रिरात्रेण विनश्यति ॥ 13 ॥
गुञ्जायाः सफलं मूलं चित्रकं तगरं तथा ॥
भल्लातकानां च फलं मूलं चैवाश्वमारकम् ॥ 14 ॥
2.11.m:
Anointment with boar's fat boiled with aśvagandhā
is declared to bring about tightening of bodily tissues for women.
One should drink one āmalaka at the proper time with a handful of water,
after it has remained in an iron vessel; by that, she becomes slender-waisted.
One should always lick triphalā, citraka, and dry ginger with honey;
this is an excellent slimming regimen for corpulent, noble women.
Having mixed aśvagandhā and payasyā, one should drink them with milk;
using this for a month, an emaciated woman becomes fleshy.
Massaging the breasts should be done with boar's fat
boiled with aśvagandhā; by this, a woman becomes full-breasted.
Fallen radish seed and likewise [seed] of tagara,
[kept] in cow's urine for seven nights, is an excellent destroyer of sidhma-leprosy.
With the ash of elephant dung and the juice of avalguja—
sprinkled with this, white leprosy (śvitra) is destroyed in three nights.
The root of guñjā along with its fruit, citraka, tagara,
the fruit of bhallātaka, and the root of aśvamāraka—

2.11.s:
arkakṣīrasamaṃ tailaṃ dravyairetairvipācayet ..
prokṣaṇena vinirdiṣṭaṃ romaśātanamuttamam .. 15 ..
2.11.d:
अर्कक्षीरसमं तैलं द्रव्यैरेतैर्विपाचयेत् ॥
प्रोक्षणेन विनिर्दिष्टं रोमशातनमुत्तमम् ॥ 15 ॥
2.11.m:
one should cook oil equal in amount to arka latex along with these substances;
by sprinkling, it is taught to be an excellent depilatory.

2.11.s:
hastidantamayīṃ piṣṭvā payasā lepayecchiraḥ ..
ajāteṣvapi keśeṣu romasañjananaṃ param .. 16 ..
2.11.d:
हस्तिदन्तमयीं पिष्ट्वा पयसा लेपयेच्छिरः ॥
अजातेष्वपि केशेषु रोमसञ्जननं परम् ॥ 16 ॥
2.11.m:
Having ground ivory [soot] with milk, one should smear it on the head;
even when hair has not grown, it is supreme for generating hair.

2.11.s:
bhṛṅgarājarasaistailaṃ siddhamabhyañjanāddrutam ..
dṛḍhamūlāni keśāni kuryātkṛṣṇāsitāni ca .. 17 ..
2.11.d:
भृङ्गराजरसैस्तैलं सिद्धमभ्यञ्जनाद्द्रुतम् ॥
दृढमूलानि केशानि कुर्यात्कृष्णासितानि च ॥ 17 ॥
2.11.m:
Oil prepared with the juices of bhṛṅgarāja quickly, from application,
makes the hairs firmly rooted and glossy black.

2.11.s:
kaṭukaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ tu gomūtraparibhāvitam ..
bhuktvā tailena gaṇḍūṣaṃ vaktragandhaharaṃ param .. ..18..
2.11.d:
कटुकं दन्तकाष्ठं तु गोमूत्रपरिभावितम् ॥
भुक्त्वा तैलेन गण्डूषं वक्त्रगन्धहरं परम् ॥ ॥18॥
2.11.m:
A bitter tooth-stick impregnated with cow's urine;
and after eating, an oil gargle is supreme in removing mouth odor.

2.11.s:
indīvarāṇi śuṣkāṇi prāśyāni taṇḍulaissaha ..
sarvarātraṃ mukhe vāti sugandhiviśadaṃ śuci ..19..
2.11.d:
इन्दीवराणि शुष्काणि प्राश्यानि तण्डुलैस्सह ॥
सर्वरात्रं मुखे वाति सुगन्धिविशदं शुचि ॥19॥
2.11.m:
Dried blue lotuses are to be eaten together with rice;
all night long, [her breath] blows sweet-smelling, clean, and pure in the mouth.

2.11.s:
sarṣaponmathitaṃ kṛtvā śālmalīnāṃ tu kaṇṭakaiḥ ..
payaḥpiṣṭairmukhe lepānmukhaṃ syātkamalopamam .. 2.52.20 ..
2.11.d:
सर्षपोन्मथितं कृत्वा शाल्मलीनां तु कण्टकैः ॥
पयःपिष्टैर्मुखे लेपान्मुखं स्यात्कमलोपमम् ॥ 2.52.20 ॥
2.11.m:
Having prepared a paste of mustard and the thorns of the silk-cotton tree
ground with milk, through application on the face, the face becomes like a lotus.

2.11.s:
vyaṅgānāṃ tilakānāṃ ca śamanaṃ tatprakīrtitam ..
yauvane piṭakānāṃ ca ye ca doṣā mukhe smṛtāḥ .. 21 ..
2.11.d:
व्यङ्गानां तिलकानां च शमनं तत्प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
यौवने पिटकानां च ये च दोषा मुखे स्मृताः ॥ 21 ॥
2.11.m:
It is declared to pacify dark facial spots, freckles,
youthful pimples, and whatever blemishes are known on the face.

2.11.s:
kaṣāyakalkasiddhena śatāvaryā ghṛtena ca ..
abhyaṅgapānairbhavati nārī varṇayutā param .. 22 ..
2.11.d:
कषायकल्कसिद्धेन शतावर्या घृतेन च ॥
अभ्यङ्गपानैर्भवति नारी वर्णयुता परम् ॥ 22 ॥
2.11.m:
By anointment and drinking of ghee prepared with the decoction and paste
of śatāvarī, a woman becomes possessed of supreme complexion.

2.11.s:
ṣoḍaśartuniśāḥ strīṇāmādyāstisrastu ninditāḥ ..
aspṛśyā tāsu nārī syātspṛṣṭvā tāṃ snānamācaret .. 23 ..
2.11.d:
षोडशर्तुनिशाः स्त्रीणामाद्यास्तिस्रस्तु निन्दिताः ॥
अस्पृश्या तासु नारी स्यात्स्पृष्ट्वा तां स्नानमाचरेत् ॥ 23 ॥
2.11.m:
Sixteen nights are the fertile period (ṛtu) of women; but the first three are censured.
During those [three nights], a woman is untouchable; having touched her, one should perform a bath.

2.11.s:
dinatrayaṃ tu tannārī snānābhyaṅgau vivarjayet ..
āhāraṃ gorasānāṃ ca puṣpālaṅkāradhāraṇam .. 24 ..
2.11.d:
दिनत्रयं तु तन्नारी स्नानाभ्यङ्गौ विवर्जयेत् ॥
आहारं गोरसानां च पुष्पालङ्कारधारणम् ॥ 24 ॥
2.11.m:
For three days that woman should avoid bathing and oil anointment,
food made from cow's milk, and wearing flowers and ornaments,

2.11.s:
añjanaṃ kaṅkaṇaṃ gandhāḥ pītaṃ śayyādhirohaṇam ..
mṛllohabhāṇḍavarjyeṣu tathā bhāṇḍeṣu bhojanam .. 25 ..
2.11.d:
अञ्जनं कङ्कणं गन्धाः पीतं शय्याधिरोहणम् ॥
मृल्लोहभाण्डवर्ज्येषु तथा भाण्डेषु भोजनम् ॥ 25 ॥
2.11.m:
collyrium, bracelets, perfumes, yellow garments, mounting a bed,
and eating in vessels other than earthenware and iron vessels.

2.11.s:
agnisaṃsparśanaṃ caiva varjayettu dinatrayam ..
caturthe'hani kurvīta snānaṃ sā tu yathāvidhi .. 26 ..
2.11.d:
अग्निसंस्पर्शनं चैव वर्जयेत्तु दिनत्रयम् ॥
चतुर्थेऽहनि कुर्वीत स्नानं सा तु यथाविधि ॥ 26 ॥
2.11.m:
And she should avoid touching fire for three days;
on the fourth day, however, she should bathe according to rule.

2.11.s:
abhiṣekoditābhiśca mṛddhiradbhiśca mānasaiḥ ..
oṣadhyaśca tathā kumbhe nikṣipya snāpayettu tām ..27..
2.11.d:
अभिषेकोदिताभिश्च मृद्धिरद्भिश्च मानसैः ॥
ओषध्यश्च तथा कुम्भे निक्षिप्य स्नापयेत्तु ताम् ॥27॥
2.11.m:
And with earths prescribed for consecration, and waters from Lake Mānasa,
and throwing herbs into a jar, one should bathe her:

2.11.s:
jyotiṣmatīṃ trāyamāṇāmabhayāmaparājitām ..
jīvāṃ viśveśvarīṃ pāṭhāṃ samaṅgāṃ vijayāṃ tathā .. 28 ..
2.11.d:
ज्योतिष्मतीं त्रायमाणामभयामपराजिताम् ॥
जीवां विश्वेश्वरीं पाठां समङ्गां विजयां तथा ॥ 28 ॥
2.11.m:
jyotiṣmatī, trāyamāṇā, abhayā, aparājitā,
jīvā, viśveśvarī, pāṭhā, samaṅgā, vijayā,

2.11.s:
sahāṃ ca sahadevīṃ ca pūrṇakośāṃ śatāvarīm ..
ariṣṭāṃ śivāṃ bhadrāṃ golomīṃ vijayapradām .. 29 ..
2.11.d:
सहां च सहदेवीं च पूर्णकोशां शतावरीम् ॥
अरिष्टां शिवां भद्रां गोलोमीं विजयप्रदाम् ॥ 29 ॥
2.11.m:
sahā, sahadevī, pūrṇakośā, śatāvarī,
ariṣṭā, śivā, bhadrā, golomī, vijayapradā,

2.11.s:
brāhmīṃ kṣetrāmajāṃ caiva sarvabījāni cāñjanam ..
bilvaṃ gandhāni ratnāni pañcagavyaṃ tathaiva ca .. 2.52.30 ..
2.11.d:
ब्राह्मीं क्षेत्रामजां चैव सर्वबीजानि चाञ्जनम् ॥
बिल्वं गन्धानि रत्नानि पञ्चगव्यं तथैव च ॥ 2.52.30 ॥
2.11.m:
brāhmī, kṣetrā, ajā, all kinds of seeds, collyrium,
bilva, perfumes, jewels, and likewise the five products of the cow (pañcagavya)—

2.11.s:
kumbhe nikṣipya kumbhaṃ ca gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ ..
pūjayitvā tato devaṃ tasyātra śubhavardhanam .. 31 ..
2.11.d:
कुम्भे निक्षिप्य कुम्भं च गन्धमाल्यानुलेपनैः ॥
पूजयित्वा ततो देवं तस्यात्र शुभवर्धनम् ॥ 31 ॥
2.11.m:
having thrown [these] into a jar and having worshiped the jar
with perfumes, garlands, and unguents, and then the deity who increases auspiciousness for her here,

2.11.s:
mantraṃ rājābhiṣekoktaṃ paṭhedatra ca kālavit ..
vastracchannamukhī snātā snāpake ca vinirgate .. .. 32 ..
2.11.d:
मन्त्रं राजाभिषेकोक्तं पठेदत्र च कालवित् ॥
वस्त्रच्छन्नमुखी स्नाता स्नापके च विनिर्गते ॥ ॥ 32 ॥
2.11.m:
the knower of proper time should recite the mantra prescribed for the royal consecration.
When she has bathed with her face covered by a cloth, and the bath-attendant has departed,

2.11.s:
paśyettadeva pratimāṃ vāsudevasya rūpiṇaḥ ..
athavā rāma bhartāraṃ nānyaṃ kaṃcana satvaram .. 33 ..
2.11.d:
पश्येत्तदेव प्रतिमां वासुदेवस्य रूपिणः ॥
अथवा राम भर्तारं नान्यं कंचन सत्वरम् ॥ 33 ॥
2.11.m:
she should promptly behold that very image of Vāsudeva in bodily form,
or else her husband, O Rāma, and no one else.

2.11.s:
tatkāle vadanaṃ tasya paśyatyatha yathā vidhi ..
sā prasūte sutaṃ rāma śubhaṃ vā'pyathavā śucim .. 34 ..
2.11.d:
तत्काले वदनं तस्य पश्यत्यथ यथा विधि ॥
सा प्रसूते सुतं राम शुभं वाऽप्यथवा शुचिम् ॥ 34 ॥
2.11.m:
Whose face she beholds at that time according to rule,
she gives birth to a son [like that person], O Rāma, either handsome or pure.

2.11.s:
pūjanaṃ vāsudevasya sā kṛtvātmana eva ca ..
maṇḍanaṃ ca yathānyāyaṃ śuklavastrottaracchadā. ..35 ..
2.11.d:
पूजनं वासुदेवस्य सा कृत्वात्मन एव च ॥
मण्डनं च यथान्यायं शुक्लवस्त्रोत्तरच्छदा॥.35 ॥
2.11.m:
Having performed the worship of Vāsudeva and also of herself,
and ornamentation according to rule, covered with white garments and an upper garment,

2.11.s:
ṣaṣṭikānnaṃ tu payasā samaśnīyād ghṛtena sā ..
ghṛtasya pītvā prasṛtiṃ nāgapuṣpāvacūrṇitam .. 36 ..
2.11.d:
षष्टिकान्नं तु पयसा समश्नीयाद् घृतेन सा ॥
घृतस्य पीत्वा प्रसृतिं नागपुष्पावचूर्णितम् ॥ 36 ॥
2.11.m:
she should eat sixty-day rice with milk and ghee;
having drunk a handful of ghee powdered with nāgapuṣpa,

2.11.s:
ṛtukāle samāpnoti nārī garbhaṃ dvijottama ..
upoṣitena śucinā śuklapakṣe samuddhṛtam .. 37 ..
2.11.d:
ऋतुकाले समाप्नोति नारी गर्भं द्विजोत्तम ॥
उपोषितेन शुचिना शुक्लपक्षे समुद्धृतम् ॥ 37 ॥
2.11.m:
at the time of the fertile period, a woman attains pregnancy, O best of the twice-born.
Extracted in the bright fortnight by one who is fasting and pure,

2.11.s:
puṣyeṇa bṛhatīmūlamuttarāṃ vā mukhe nayeta ..
śvetapuṣpā tu bṛhatī drumūlasyaiṣa niścayaḥ ..38..
2.11.d:
पुष्येण बृहतीमूलमुत्तरां वा मुखे नयेत ॥
श्वेतपुष्पा तु बृहती द्रुमूलस्यैष निश्चयः ॥38॥
2.11.m:
under Puṣya or the Uttara constellations, she should put the root of bṛhatī into her mouth;
the white-flowered bṛhatī is the determination for this tree-root.

2.11.s:
nasyā deyāśca catvāra unmūlā drumabindavaḥ ..
tasminnahani sā tena garbhaṃ dhatte varāṃganā .. 39 ..
2.11.d:
नस्या देयाश्च चत्वार उन्मूला द्रुमबिन्दवः ॥
तस्मिन्नहनि सा तेन गर्भं धत्ते वरांगना ॥ 39 ॥
2.11.m:
Four drops of the tree root are to be given as nasal drops;
on that day, by that, the noble woman conceives an embryo.

2.11.s:
evamapyabhavantī tu putrīyāṃ rāma saptamīm ..
putrīyamathavā snānaṃ keśavārādhanaṃ vratam .. 2.52.40 ..
2.11.d:
एवमप्यभवन्ती तु पुत्रीयां राम सप्तमीम् ॥
पुत्रीयमथवा स्नानं केशवाराधनं व्रतम् ॥ 2.52.40 ॥
2.11.m:
Even if this does not happen, O Rāma, [she should observe] the Seventh Day for obtaining a son,
or the son-bestowing bath, or the observance of worshiping Keśava.

2.11.s:
putrīyameva vā kuryātkeśavārādhanaṃ priyā ..
snātānuliptā bhartāraṃ hṛṣṭairbṛṃhitameva ca .. 41 ..
2.11.d:
पुत्रीयमेव वा कुर्यात्केशवाराधनं प्रिया ॥
स्नातानुलिप्ता भर्तारं हृष्टैर्बृंहितमेव च ॥ 41 ॥
2.11.m:
Or the beloved wife should perform the worship of Keśava for obtaining a son.
Bathed and anointed, she should go at night to her husband,

2.11.s:
yāyādrātrau tathā nārī gandhadhūpādivāsitā ..
āttagarbhāṃ cikitseta tatastāmaparājita .. 42 ..
2.11.d:
यायाद्रात्रौ तथा नारी गन्धधूपादिवासिता ॥
आत्तगर्भां चिकित्सेत ततस्तामपराजित ॥ 42 ॥
2.11.m:
who is invigorated by joyful attendants, while she is perfumed with fragrances and incense.
Then, once she has conceived an embryo, O unconquered one, one should treat her

2.11.s:
madhurauṣadhisiddhena payasā sarpiṣā tathā ..
icchāvimānagāḥ kāścinnāsyāḥ kāryā kathañcana .. 43 ..
2.11.d:
मधुरौषधिसिद्धेन पयसा सर्पिषा तथा ॥
इच्छाविमानगाः काश्चिन्नास्याः कार्या कथञ्चन ॥ 43 ॥
2.11.m:
with milk and ghee prepared with sweet herbs.
No desires of hers that contravene her longing should ever be caused.

2.11.s:
kaṭutiktakaṣāyāṇi cātyuṣṇalavaṇāni ca ..
āyāsaṃ ca vyavāyaṃ ca garbhiṇī varjayetsadā .. 44 ..
2.11.d:
कटुतिक्तकषायाणि चात्युष्णलवणानि च ॥
आयासं च व्यवायं च गर्भिणी वर्जयेत्सदा ॥ 44 ॥
2.11.m:
Pungent, bitter, and astringent, extremely hot and salty foods,
exertion, and sexual intercourse: a pregnant woman should always avoid these.

2.11.s:
vinā karma na tiṣṭheta tathā sā rāhudarśane ..
prādurbhāvāṇi vedesya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ .. 45 ..
2.11.d:
विना कर्म न तिष्ठेत तथा सा राहुदर्शने ॥
प्रादुर्भावाणि वेदेस्य विष्णोरमिततेजसः ॥ 45 ॥
2.11.m: Likewise, upon seeing [an eclipse of] Rāhu, she should not remain without performing a religious rite. / She should hear the manifestations of Viṣṇu of immeasurable radiance

2.11.s:
śṛṇuyāttanmanā bhūtvā caritaṃ ca mahātmanaḥ ..
punnāmni nāmanakṣatre hyāsannaprasavā gṛham .. 46 ..
2.11.d:
शृणुयात्तन्मना भूत्वा चरितं च महात्मनः ॥
पुन्नाम्नि नामनक्षत्रे ह्यासन्नप्रसवा गृहम् ॥ 46 ॥
2.11.m: and the deeds of that Great-souled One, with her mind fixed on Him. / When childbirth is near, in a male asterism or an auspicious asterism,

2.11.s:
praviśetsūtikāsaṃjñaṃ kṛtarakṣaṃ samantataḥ ..
subhūmau nirmitaṃ ramyaṃ vāstuvidyāviśāradaiḥ .. 47 ..
2.11.d:
प्रविशेत्सूतिकासंज्ञं कृतरक्षं समन्ततः ॥
सुभूमौ निर्मितं रम्यं वास्तुविद्याविशारदैः ॥ 47 ॥
2.11.m: she should enter the house called the lying-in chamber, which has been protected on all sides, / built on good ground, delightful, by experts in the science of architecture,

2.11.s:
prāgdvāramuttaradvāramathavā sudṛḍhaṃ śubham ..
devānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca gavāṃ kṛtvā ca pūjanam .. 48 ..
2.11.d:
प्राग्द्वारमुत्तरद्वारमथवा सुदृढं शुभम् ॥
देवानां ब्राह्मणानां च गवां कृत्वा च पूजनम् ॥ 48 ॥
2.11.m: with an eastern or northern door, very firm and auspicious. / Having worshipped the gods, the brahmins, and the cows,

2.11.s:
vipra puṇyāhaghoṣeṇa śaṃkhavādyaraveṇa ca ..
prasūtā bahuśastatra tathā kleśakṣamāśca yāḥ .. 49 ..
2.11.d:
विप्र पुण्याहघोषेण शंखवाद्यरवेण च ॥
प्रसूता बहुशस्तत्र तथा क्लेशक्षमाश्च याः ॥ 49 ॥
2.11.m: O brahmin, to the chanting of 'Auspicious day!' and the sound of conches and musical instruments, / women who have given birth many times and are capable of enduring hardships,

2.11.s:
hṛdyā viśvasanīyāśca paricareyuḥ striyaśca tām ..
vātānulomanairhṛdyaistatraināmupacārayet .. 2.52.50 ..
2.11.d:
हृद्या विश्वसनीयाश्च परिचरेयुः स्त्रियश्च ताम् ॥
वातानुलोमनैर्हृद्यैस्तत्रैनामुपचारयेत् ॥ 2.52.50 ॥
2.11.m: charming and trustworthy, should attend upon her. / There one should care for her with delightful things that soothe the bodily wind,

2.11.s:
āhāraiśca vihāraiśca prasavāya sukhaṃ dvija ..
eraṇḍamūlamiśreṇa saghṛtena tathaiva tām .. 51 ..
2.11.d:
आहारैश्च विहारैश्च प्रसवाय सुखं द्विज ॥
एरण्डमूलमिश्रेण सघृतेन तथैव ताम् ॥ 51 ॥
2.11.m: both food and activities that ensure an easy delivery, O twice-born. / Likewise, with [a paste of] castor root mixed with clarified butter,

2.11.s:
sukhaprasavanārthāya paścātkāye tu mrakṣayet ..
balākalkakaṣāyeṇa siddhaṃ kṣīraṃ caturguṇam .. 52 ..
2.11.d:
सुखप्रसवनार्थाय पश्चात्काये तु म्रक्षयेत् ॥
बलाकल्ककषायेण सिद्धं क्षीरं चतुर्गुणम् ॥ 52 ॥
2.11.m: she should smear her lower body for the sake of an easy delivery. / Milk boiled with four times its quantity of a decoction and paste of balā

2.11.s:
tailamabhyañjanārthāya sūtāyāmupakalpayet ..
atha jātānna pānecchāṃ pañcakolaprasāditām .. 53 ..
2.11.d:
तैलमभ्यञ्जनार्थाय सूतायामुपकल्पयेत् ॥
अथ जातान्न पानेच्छां पञ्चकोलप्रसादिताम् ॥ 53 ॥
2.11.m: mixed with oil should be prepared for massage for the woman who has given birth. / Then, when she feels a desire for food and drink, flavored with pañcakola,

2.11.s:
pibedyavāgūṃ sasnehāṃ tathā vai nīlakuñcikām ..
daśāhaṃ sūtikāgāraṃ cāyudhaiśca viśeṣataḥ .. 54 ..
2.11.d:
पिबेद्यवागूं सस्नेहां तथा वै नीलकुञ्चिकाम् ॥
दशाहं सूतिकागारं चायुधैश्च विशेषतः ॥ 54 ॥
2.11.m: she should drink gruel containing fat and also black cumin. / For ten days the lying-in room [must be guarded], especially with weapons,

2.11.s:
vahni kātindukālātaiḥ pūrṇakumbhaiḥ pradīpakaiḥ ..
musalena tathā dvāri varṇakaiścitritena ca .. 55 ..
2.11.d:
वह्नि कातिन्दुकालातैः पूर्णकुम्भैः प्रदीपकैः ॥
मुसलेन तथा द्वारि वर्णकैश्चित्रितेन च ॥ 55 ॥
2.11.m: with fire, glowing cinders of tinduka wood, full jars, lamps, / and with a pestle decorated with pigments at the doorway.

2.11.s:
rakṣaṇīyā tathā ṣaṣṭhī niśā tatra viśeṣataḥ ..
rāma jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ janmadānāṃ tathārcanam .. 56 ..
2.11.d:
रक्षणीया तथा षष्ठी निशा तत्र विशेषतः ॥
राम जागरणं कार्यं जन्मदानां तथार्चनम् ॥ 56 ॥
2.11.m: The sixth night in particular must be guarded there. / O Rāma, a vigil should be kept, and worship should be offered to the goddesses of birth.

2.11.s:
puruṣāḥ śastrahastāśca nṛtyagītaiśca yoṣitaḥ ..
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryurdaśame'hani sūtikā .. 57 ..
2.11.d:
पुरुषाः शस्त्रहस्ताश्च नृत्यगीतैश्च योषितः ॥
रात्रौ जागरणं कुर्युर्दशमेऽहनि सूतिका ॥ 57 ॥
2.11.m: Men with weapons in hand and women with dances and songs / should keep vigil at night. On the tenth day, the woman in childbed,

2.11.s:
snātā pūrvavidhānena rakṣaṇīyā samīraṇāt ..
bālasya jātamātrasya nābhiṃ chittvā yathāvidhi .. 58 ..
2.11.d:
स्नाता पूर्वविधानेन रक्षणीया समीरणात् ॥
बालस्य जातमात्रस्य नाभिं छित्त्वा यथाविधि ॥ 58 ॥
2.11.m: bathed according to previous rule, should be protected from the wind. / As soon as the child is born, the navel cord having been cut according to rule,

2.11.s:
tālumuttāpayennārī picunā śodhayenmukham ..
brāhmī suvarcalā somaṃ saindhavaṃ pippalī vacā .. 59 ..
2.11.d:
तालुमुत्तापयेन्नारी पिचुना शोधयेन्मुखम् ॥
ब्राह्मी सुवर्चला सोमं सैन्धवं पिप्पली वचा ॥ 59 ॥
2.11.m: a woman should warm [the baby’s] palate and cleanse the mouth with a piece of cloth. / Brāhmī, suvarcalā, soma, rock salt, long pepper, sweet flag,

2.11.s:
kanakaṃ sarpiṣā dadyāllehyametaddvijottama ..
lehyenānena medhāvī śūraḥ paṇḍita eva ca .. 2.52.60 ..
2.11.d:
कनकं सर्पिषा दद्याल्लेह्यमेतद्द्विजोत्तम ॥
लेह्येनानेन मेधावी शूरः पण्डित एव च ॥ 2.52.60 ॥
2.11.m: and gold should be given with clarified butter as an electuary, O best of the twice-born. / By means of this electuary, [the child] will become intelligent, brave, learned,

2.11.s:
darśanīyo yaśasvī ca subhagaḥ sa bhaviṣyati ..
bibhītakāsthi kṣaudreṇa ghṛṣṭaṃ śreṣṭhamathāñjanam .. 61 ..
2.11.d:
दर्शनीयो यशस्वी च सुभगः स भविष्यति ॥
बिभीतकास्थि क्षौद्रेण घृष्टं श्रेष्ठमथाञ्जनम् ॥ 61 ॥
2.11.m: handsome, renowned, and fortunate. / The stone of a bibhītaka rubbed with honey is an excellent collyrium;

2.11.s:
netrarogeṣu bālānāṃ saharidraṃ ca gorasam ..
śārivā candanaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ samabhāgāni kārayet ..62..
2.11.d:
नेत्ररोगेषु बालानां सहरिद्रं च गोरसम् ॥
शारिवा चन्दनं कुष्ठं समभागानि कारयेत् ॥62॥
2.11.m: and for eye diseases of children, [take] milk with turmeric. / Śārivā, sandalwood, and costus should be taken in equal parts;

2.11.s:
śirolepamidaṃ dadyādakṣirogavināśanam ..
āmrāsthi saindhavaṃ lājā madhunā saha lehayet ..63..
2.11.d:
शिरोलेपमिदं दद्यादक्षिरोगविनाशनम् ॥
आम्रास्थि सैन्धवं लाजा मधुना सह लेहयेत् ॥63॥
2.11.m: one should apply this paste on the head, which cures eye diseases. / Mango stone, rock salt, and parched grain should be licked with honey;

2.11.s:
eṣa lehavaraḥ śreṣṭhaśchardipraśamanaḥ śubhaḥ ..
apāmārgaviḍaṅgāni pippalī maricaṃ tathā .. 64 ..
2.11.d:
एष लेहवरः श्रेष्ठश्छर्दिप्रशमनः शुभः ॥
अपामार्गविडङ्गानि पिप्पली मरिचं तथा ॥ 64 ॥
2.11.m: this excellent electuary is auspicious and relieves vomiting. / Apāmārga, viḍaṅga, long pepper, and black pepper,

2.11.s:
saindhavaṃ taṇḍulaṃ caiva madhusarpiḥsamanvitam ..
vyāghrīrasena leho'yaṃ hikkāśvāsavināśanaḥ .. 65 ..
2.11.d:
सैन्धवं तण्डुलं चैव मधुसर्पिःसमन्वितम् ॥
व्याघ्रीरसेन लेहोऽयं हिक्काश्वासविनाशनः ॥ 65 ॥
2.11.m: rock salt, and rice, mixed with honey and clarified butter, / as an electuary with juice of vyāghrī, destroys hiccup and asthma.

2.11.s:
bibhītakatvacā śreṣṭhaṃ haritālaṃ manaḥśilā ..
etattailaṃ paceddadrupāmākiṭibhanāśanam .. 66 ..
2.11.d:
बिभीतकत्वचा श्रेष्ठं हरितालं मनःशिला ॥
एतत्तैलं पचेद्दद्रुपामाकिटिभनाशनम् ॥ 66 ॥
2.11.m: Bibhītaka bark, excellent orpiment, and realgar: / an oil cooked with these cures ringworm, scabies, and kiṭibha.

2.11.s:
kṣaudreṇa lehyā tuvarā pippalyativiṣāpahā ..
śleṣmarogeṣu sarveṣu bālānāṃ bheṣajaṃ param .. 67 ..
2.11.d:
क्षौद्रेण लेह्या तुवरा पिप्पल्यतिविषापहा ॥
श्लेष्मरोगेषु सर्वेषु बालानां भेषजं परम् ॥ 67 ॥
2.11.m: Astringent bark should be licked with honey, [along with] long pepper and ativiṣā; / this is the supreme medicine for children in all diseases of phlegm.

2.11.s:
rodhratvaṅmadhunā sārdhamatīsāravināśinī ..
sapta parṇatvak ca dūrvā tathā kaṭukarohiṇī .. 68 ..
2.11.d:
रोध्रत्वङ्मधुना सार्धमतीसारविनाशिनी ॥
सप्त पर्णत्वक् च दूर्वा तथा कटुकरोहिणी ॥ 68 ॥
2.11.m: Lodhra bark with honey destroys diarrhea. / Bark of saptaparṇa, dūrvā grass, and kaṭukarohiṇī:

2.11.s:
etadudvartanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvagrahavināśanam ..
bhaṅgāṃ vacāṃ śaṅkhapuṣpīmeraṇḍasaptaparṇakam .. 69 ..
2.11.d:
एतदुद्वर्तनं श्रेष्ठं सर्वग्रहविनाशनम् ॥
भङ्गां वचां शङ्खपुष्पीमेरण्डसप्तपर्णकम् ॥ 69 ॥
2.11.m: this is an excellent unguent that destroys all seizing spirits. / Bhaṅgā, sweet flag, śaṅkhapuṣpī, castor, saptaparṇa,

2.11.s:
samantapuṣpīsaṃyuktamapāmārgaṃ ca puṣkaram ..
kvāthayitvā ca dātavyaṃ snānaṃ sadyaḥ sukhāvaham ..2.52.70 ..
2.11.d:
समन्तपुष्पीसंयुक्तमपामार्गं च पुष्करम् ॥
क्वाथयित्वा च दातव्यं स्नानं सद्यः सुखावहम् ॥2.52.70 ॥
2.11.m: together with samantapuṣpī, apāmārga, and puṣkara: / boiled into a decoction, a bath should be given, which brings immediate ease.

2.11.s:
sarpiṣā nimbapatrāṇi goviṣāṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu ..
etena dhūpito bālo grahadoṣairvimucyate .. 71 ..
2.11.d:
सर्पिषा निम्बपत्राणि गोविषाणं घृतं मधु ॥
एतेन धूपितो बालो ग्रहदोषैर्विमुच्यते ॥ 71 ॥
2.11.m: With clarified butter, neem leaves, cow horn, ghee, and honey: / a child fumigated with this is freed from the afflictions of seizing spirits.

2.11.s:
apāmārgasya bījāni bilvamūlaphalāni ca ..
aguruṃ candanaṃ caiva saptaparṇasya valkalam .. 72 ..
2.11.d:
अपामार्गस्य बीजानि बिल्वमूलफलानि च ॥
अगुरुं चन्दनं चैव सप्तपर्णस्य वल्कलम् ॥ 72 ॥
2.11.m: Seeds of apāmārga, root and fruit of bilva, / eaglewood, sandalwood, and bark of saptaparṇa:

2.11.s:
etadālepanaṃ kuryātsarvagrahavināśanam ..
mātaraśca grahāścaiva bālaṃ tu balikarmaṇā .. 73 ..
2.11.d:
एतदालेपनं कुर्यात्सर्वग्रहविनाशनम् ॥
मातरश्च ग्रहाश्चैव बालं तु बलिकर्मणा ॥ 73 ॥
2.11.m: one should make an ointment of these, which destroys all seizing spirits. / The mother-goddesses and seizing spirits release the child quickly

2.11.s:
kṣiprameva pramuñcanti tasmādyatnena kārayet ..
tarakṣvarkṣa varāhāṇāṃ daṃṣṭrā gorocanā vacā .. 74 ..
2.11.d:
क्षिप्रमेव प्रमुञ्चन्ति तस्माद्यत्नेन कारयेत् ॥
तरक्ष्वर्क्ष वराहाणां दंष्ट्रा गोरोचना वचा ॥ 74 ॥
2.11.m: through the rite of food offerings; therefore one should perform it with effort. / The teeth of a hyena, bear, and boar, gorocanā, sweet flag,

2.11.s:
ratnānyayastathā kṛṣṇaṃ vastraṃ dhāryaṃ tu bālakaiḥ ..
jātasya rāma bālasya hemante prathame'thavā .. 75 ..
2.11.d:
रत्नान्ययस्तथा कृष्णं वस्त्रं धार्यं तु बालकैः ॥
जातस्य राम बालस्य हेमन्ते प्रथमेऽथवा ॥ 75 ॥
2.11.m: gems, iron, and black cloth should be worn by children. / O Rāma, for a child born, either in the first winter

2.11.s:
śiśire vāpi kartavyaṃ karṇavedhaṃ tathā śṛṇu ..
grahāṇāṃ tatra sarveṣāṃ dinavāraḥ praśasyate .. 76 ..
2.11.d:
शिशिरे वापि कर्तव्यं कर्णवेधं तथा शृणु ॥
ग्रहाणां तत्र सर्वेषां दिनवारः प्रशस्यते ॥ 76 ॥
2.11.m: or in the cool season, ear-piercing should be performed; hear that. / The weekday of all planets is praised in that regard,

2.11.s:
tithiṃ caturthīṃ navamīṃ varjayitvā caturdaśīm ..
sāvitraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tvāṣṭramādityaṃ pauṣṇamāśvinam .. 77 ..
2.11.d:
तिथिं चतुर्थीं नवमीं वर्जयित्वा चतुर्दशीम् ॥
सावित्रं वैष्णवं त्वाष्ट्रमादित्यं पौष्णमाश्विनम् ॥ 77 ॥
2.11.m: avoiding the fourth, ninth, and fourteenth lunar day. / Sāvitra, Vaiṣṇava, Tvāṣṭra, Āditya, Pauṣṇa, Āśvina,

2.11.s:
karṇavedhe praśasyante somadevaṃ tathaiva ca ..
pūrvāhṇe pūjanaṃ kṛtvā keśavasya harasya ca .. 78 ..
2.11.d:
कर्णवेधे प्रशस्यन्ते सोमदेवं तथैव च ॥
पूर्वाह्णे पूजनं कृत्वा केशवस्य हरस्य च ॥ 78 ॥
2.11.m: and Somadaiva are praised for ear-piercing. / In the forenoon, having performed worship of Keśava, Hara,

2.11.s:
brahmaṇaścandrasūryābhyāṃ digīśānāṃ tathaiva ca ..
nāsatyayoḥ sarasvatyā brāhmaṇānāṃ gavāṃ tathā .. 79 ..
2.11.d:
ब्रह्मणश्चन्द्रसूर्याभ्यां दिगीशानां तथैव च ॥
नासत्ययोः सरस्वत्या ब्राह्मणानां गवां तथा ॥ 79 ॥
2.11.m: Brahmā, the moon and sun, the guardians of the directions, / the two Nāsatyas, Sarasvatī, brahmins, cows,

2.11.s:
gurūṇāṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā tatra dattvā sukhāsanam ..
dattvopaveśayettatra dhātrīṃ śuklāmbarāṃ tathā ..2.52.80..
2.11.d:
गुरूणां मण्डलं कृत्वा तत्र दत्त्वा सुखासनम् ॥
दत्त्वोपवेशयेत्तत्र धात्रीं शुक्लाम्बरां तथा ॥2.52.80॥
2.11.m: and teachers, having made a sacred diagram, having provided a comfortable seat there, / one should seat the wet-nurse there, dressed in white garments,

2.11.s:
svalaṃkṛtāṃ tadutsaṃge bālaṃ kṛtvā tu sāntvitam ..
dhṛtasya niścalaṃ samyaggale kukarasāṃkite..81..
2.11.d:
स्वलंकृतां तदुत्संगे बालं कृत्वा तु सान्त्वितम् ॥
धृतस्य निश्चलं सम्यग्गले कुकरसांकिते॥81॥
2.11.m: well-adorned, having placed the comforted child in her lap; / and holding [the ear] firmly steady on the neck marked with a good line,

2.11.s:
vidhyeddaivakṛte chidre sakṛdeva tu lāghavāt ..
prāgdakṣiṇaṃ kumārasya bhiṣagvāmaṃ tu yoṣitaḥ ..
snehāktaṃ sūcyanusyūtaṃ sūtraṃ vānunidhāpayet .. 82 ..
2.11.d:
विध्येद्दैवकृते छिद्रे सकृदेव तु लाघवात् ॥
प्राग्दक्षिणं कुमारस्य भिषग्वामं तु योषितः ॥
स्नेहाक्तं सूच्यनुस्यूतं सूत्रं वानुनिधापयेत् ॥ 82 ॥
2.11.m: the physician should pierce the naturally formed aperture in a single stroke, adroitly, / first the right for a boy, and the left for a girl; / and he should insert a thread lubricated with oil and threaded on a needle.

2.11.s:
tailābhyakte tataḥ karṇe kāryamābharaṇaṃ bhavet ..
karṇavedhadine vipraṃ sāṃvatsaracikitsakau ..
pūjyāścāvidhavā nāryaḥ suhṛdaśca tathā dvijāḥ .. .. 83 ..
2.11.d:
तैलाभ्यक्ते ततः कर्णे कार्यमाभरणं भवेत् ॥
कर्णवेधदिने विप्रं सांवत्सरचिकित्सकौ ॥
पूज्याश्चाविधवा नार्यः सुहृदश्च तथा द्विजाः ॥ ॥ 83 ॥
2.11.m: Then, on the ear anointed with oil, an ornament should be placed. / On the day of ear-piercing, a brahmin, the astrologer, and the physician,

2.11.s:
caturthe māsi kartavyaṃ śiśorniṣkramaṇaṃ gṛhāt ..
saurabhaumadinaṃ caiva tithiṃ riktāṃ ca varjayet .. 84 ..
2.11.d:
चतुर्थे मासि कर्तव्यं शिशोर्निष्क्रमणं गृहात् ॥
सौरभौमदिनं चैव तिथिं रिक्तां च वर्जयेत् ॥ 84 ॥
2.11.m: as well as married women, friends, and twice-borns should be honoured. / In the fourth month, the child's departure from the house should be performed.

2.11.s:
caturthīṃ navamīṃ caiva riktāṃ caiva caturdaśīm ..
āryamṇaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ hastamādityaṃ pauṣamaśvinam .. 85 ..
2.11.d:
चतुर्थीं नवमीं चैव रिक्तां चैव चतुर्दशीम् ॥
आर्यम्णं वैष्णवं हस्तमादित्यं पौषमश्विनम् ॥ 85 ॥
2.11.m: One should avoid Saturday and Tuesday, and an empty lunar day: / the fourth, the ninth, and the empty fourteenth. / Āryamṇa, Vaiṣṇava, Hasta, Āditya, Pauṣṇa, Āśvina,

2.11.s:
bhāgyaṃ tvāṣṭraṃ ca puṣyaṃ ca tatra karmaṇi śasyate ..
digīśānāṃ diśaṃ tatra tathā candrārkayordvija .. 86 ..
2.11.d:
भाग्यं त्वाष्ट्रं च पुष्यं च तत्र कर्मणि शस्यते ॥
दिगीशानां दिशं तत्र तथा चन्द्रार्कयोर्द्विज ॥ 86 ॥
2.11.m: Bhāgya, Tvāṣṭra, and Puṣya are praised for that rite. / There, O twice-born, having performed worship of the guardians of the directions in their directions,

2.11.s:
pūjanaṃ vāsudevasya gaganasya ca kārayet ..
tatra svalaṃkṛtā dhātrī bālamādāya pūjitam .. 87 ..
2.11.d:
पूजनं वासुदेवस्य गगनस्य च कारयेत् ॥
तत्र स्वलंकृता धात्री बालमादाय पूजितम् ॥ 87 ॥
2.11.m: as well as of the moon and sun, of Vāsudeva, and of the sky, / the nurse, well-adorned, taking the worshipped child,

2.11.s:
bahirniṣkrāmayedgehācchaṅkhapuṇyāhanisvanaiḥ ..
tatastatra paṭhenmaṃtraṃ yaṃ tu rāma nibodha me..88..
2.11.d:
बहिर्निष्क्रामयेद्गेहाच्छङ्खपुण्याहनिस्वनैः ॥
ततस्तत्र पठेन्मंत्रं यं तु राम निबोध मे॥88॥
2.11.m: she should carry [the child] out of the house to the sounds of conches and [proclamations of] an auspicious day. / Then one should recite there the mantra which, O Rāma, learn from me:

2.11.s:
candrārkayordigīśānāṃ diśāṃ ca gaganasya ca ..
nikṣepārthamidaṃ dadmi te me rakṣantu sarvadā ..89..
2.11.d:
चन्द्रार्कयोर्दिगीशानां दिशां च गगनस्य च ॥
निक्षेपार्थमिदं दद्मि ते मे रक्षन्तु सर्वदा ॥89॥
2.11.m: “To the sun and moon, to the lords of the quarters, to the directions, and to the sky / I give this [child] as a deposit; may they protect [him] for me at all times.

2.11.s:
apramattaṃ pramattaṃ vā divā rātrāvathāpi vā ..
rakṣantu sarvataḥ sarve devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ .. 2.52.90 ..
2.11.d:
अप्रमत्तं प्रमत्तं वा दिवा रात्रावथापि वा ॥
रक्षन्तु सर्वतः सर्वे देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः ॥ 2.52.90 ॥
2.11.m: Attentive or inattentive, by day or even by night, / may all the gods, led by Śakra, protect [him] on all sides.”

2.11.s:
strīṇāmavidhavānāṃ tu dvijānāṃ suhṛdāṃ tathā ..
tadā tu pūjā kartavyā gītanṛtyaistathotsavaiḥ .. 91 ..
2.11.d:
स्त्रीणामविधवानां तु द्विजानां सुहृदां तथा ॥
तदा तु पूजा कर्तव्या गीतनृत्यैस्तथोत्सवैः ॥ 91 ॥
2.11.m: Then worship of women whose husbands are living, of twice-born [men], and of friends / should be performed with song, dance, and festivities.

2.11.s:
pañcame ca tathā māsi bhūmau tamupaveśayet ..
tatra sarve grahāḥ śastā bhaumo rāma viśeṣataḥ .. 92 ..
2.11.d:
पञ्चमे च तथा मासि भूमौ तमुपवेशयेत् ॥
तत्र सर्वे ग्रहाः शस्ता भौमो राम विशेषतः ॥ 92 ॥
2.11.m: And likewise in the fifth month, one should seat him upon the earth; / on that [occasion] all planets are auspicious, especially Mars, O Rāma.

2.11.s:
tithiṃ ca varjayedriktāmṛkṣāṇi śṛṇu bhārgava ..
uttarātritayaṃ saumyaṃ cāśvatthaṃ śakradaivatam .. 93 ..
2.11.d:
तिथिं च वर्जयेद्रिक्तामृक्षाणि शृणु भार्गव ॥
उत्तरात्रितयं सौम्यं चाश्वत्थं शक्रदैवतम् ॥ 93 ॥
2.11.m: And one should avoid an empty lunar day; hear the lunar mansions, O Bhārgava: / the triad of Uttarās, that of Soma (Mṛgaśīrṣa), Aśvattha (Puṣya), that whose deity is Śakra (Jyeṣṭhā),

2.11.s:
prājāpatyaṃ ca hastaṃ ca śastamāśvinadaivatam ..
varāhaṃ pūjayeddevaṃ pṛthivīṃ ca dvijottama .. 94 ..
2.11.d:
प्राजापत्यं च हस्तं च शस्तमाश्विनदैवतम् ॥
वराहं पूजयेद्देवं पृथिवीं च द्विजोत्तम ॥ 94 ॥
2.11.m: that belonging to Prajāpati (Rohiṇī), Hasta, and that whose deity is the Aśvins (Aśvinī) are commended. / One should worship the god Varāha and the Earth, O best of the twice-born.

2.11.s:
pūjanaṃ sarvataḥ kṛtvā gurudevadvijanmanām ..
bhūbhāgamupalipyātha kṛtvā tatra tu maṇḍalam .. 95 ..
2.11.d:
पूजनं सर्वतः कृत्वा गुरुदेवद्विजन्मनाम् ॥
भूभागमुपलिप्याथ कृत्वा तत्र तु मण्डलम् ॥ 95 ॥
2.11.m: Having performed worship everywhere of the gurus, gods, and twice-born, / and having smeared a patch of ground and made a maṇḍala there,

2.11.s:
śaṅkhapuṇyāhaśabdena bhūmau tamupaveśayet ..
mantraścātra bhavedrāma tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu .. 96 ..
2.11.d:
शङ्खपुण्याहशब्देन भूमौ तमुपवेशयेत् ॥
मन्त्रश्चात्र भवेद्राम तन्मे निगदतः शृणु ॥ 96 ॥
2.11.m: one should seat him upon the earth to the sound of conches and [proclamations of] an auspicious day. / And here there is a mantra, O Rāma; hear it from me as I speak it:

2.11.s:
rakṣaṇaṃ vasudhe devi sadā sarvagataṃ śubhe ..
āyuḥpramāṇaṃ sakalaṃ nikṣepaste haripriye .. 97 ..
2.11.d:
रक्षणं वसुधे देवि सदा सर्वगतं शुभे ॥
आयुःप्रमाणं सकलं निक्षेपस्ते हरिप्रिये ॥ 97 ॥
2.11.m: “O goddess Earth, auspicious one, protection everywhere is ever [yours]; / the full measure of life is your deposit, O beloved of Hari.

2.11.s:
antarādāyuṣastasya ye kecitparipanthinaḥ ..
jīvitārogyavitteṣu nirdahasvācireṇa tān .. 98 ..
2.11.d:
अन्तरादायुषस्तस्य ये केचित्परिपन्थिनः ॥
जीवितारोग्यवित्तेषु निर्दहस्वाचिरेण तान् ॥ 98 ॥
2.11.m: Whoever are adversaries standing in the way of his life, / of his longevity, health, and wealth, burn them without delay!

2.11.s:
vareṇyāśeṣabhūtānāṃ mātā tvamasi kāmadhuk ..
ajarā cāprameyā ca sarvabhūtanamaskṛtā .. 99 ..
2.11.d:
वरेण्याशेषभूतानां माता त्वमसि कामधुक् ॥
अजरा चाप्रमेया च सर्वभूतनमस्कृता ॥ 99 ॥
2.11.m: You are the mother, the wish-fulfilling cow, the choice of all beings; / unaging and immeasurable, bowed to by all creatures,

2.11.s:
carācarāṇāṃ bhūtānāṃ pratiṣṭhā tvaṃ tvarhamasi ..
kumāraṃ pāhi mātastvaṃ bālaṃ tadanumanyatām .. 2.52.100 ..
2.11.d:
चराचराणां भूतानां प्रतिष्ठा त्वं त्वर्हमसि ॥
कुमारं पाहि मातस्त्वं बालं तदनुमन्यताम् ॥ 2.52.100 ॥
2.11.m: you are indeed worthy to be the foundation of moving and unmoving beings. / Protect the boy, O Mother; may [she] show favor to the child!”

2.11.s:
tasyopaveśanaṃ kṛtvā bhūmau brāhmaṇabhojanam ..
śaktyā kṛtvā tataḥ kāryaścotsavaḥ pūrvavaddvija .. 101 ..
2.11.d:
तस्योपवेशनं कृत्वा भूमौ ब्राह्मणभोजनम् ॥
शक्त्या कृत्वा ततः कार्यश्चोत्सवः पूर्ववद्द्विज ॥ 101 ॥
2.11.m: Having seated him upon the earth, feeding of brahmins / should be done according to one's capacity, and then, O twice-born, a celebration should be held as before.

2.11.s:
ṣaṣṭhe'nnaprāśanaṃ māsi kartavyaṃ bhaumavarjite ..
dinavāre tithiṃ riktāṃ varjanīyā tathaiva ca .. 102 ..
2.11.d:
षष्ठेऽन्नप्राशनं मासि कर्तव्यं भौमवर्जिते ॥
दिनवारे तिथिं रिक्तां वर्जनीया तथैव च ॥ 102 ॥
2.11.m: In the sixth month, the first feeding of solid food should be performed on a day of the week / free from Mars; similarly, an empty lunar day is to be avoided.

2.11.s:
nakṣatrāṇi tathaivātra dāruṇogrāṇi varjayet ..
sādhāraṇe tathā rāma jyeṣṭhānteṣvapi śasyate .. 103 ..
2.11.d:
नक्षत्राणि तथैवात्र दारुणोग्राणि वर्जयेत् ॥
साधारणे तथा राम ज्येष्ठान्तेष्वपि शस्यते ॥ 103 ॥
2.11.m: Likewise, on this occasion, harsh and fierce lunar mansions are to be avoided; / O Rāma, [those that are] common and those that end in Jyeṣṭhā are commended.

2.11.s:
brahmāṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ viṣṇuṃ candrārkau ca digīśvarān ..
bhuvaṃ diśaśca sampūjya hutvā vahnau tathā carum .. 104 ..
2.11.d:
ब्रह्माणं शङ्करं विष्णुं चन्द्रार्कौ च दिगीश्वरान् ॥
भुवं दिशश्च सम्पूज्य हुत्वा वह्नौ तथा चरुम् ॥ 104 ॥
2.11.m: Having worshipped Brahmā, Śaṅkara, Viṣṇu, the sun and moon, the lords of the quarters, / the earth, and the directions, and having offered caru into the fire,

2.11.s:
eteṣāmeva devānāṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇapūjanam ..
devatāpuratastasya dhātryutsaṅgagatasya ca .. 105 ..
2.11.d:
एतेषामेव देवानां कृत्वा ब्राह्मणपूजनम् ॥
देवतापुरतस्तस्य धात्र्युत्सङ्गगतस्य च ॥ 105 ॥
2.11.m: and having performed worship of brahmins for these very gods, / in front of the deity, while he rests in the lap of his nurse,

2.11.s:
alaṃkṛtasya dātavyaṃ vīra kāṃsye tu kāñcane ..
madhvājyakanakopetaṃ prāśayetpāyasaṃ tataḥ .. 106 ..
2.11.d:
अलंकृतस्य दातव्यं वीर कांस्ये तु काञ्चने ॥
मध्वाज्यकनकोपेतं प्राशयेत्पायसं ततः ॥ 106 ॥
2.11.m: and is adorned, [it] should be given, O hero, in a bronze or golden [vessel]; / then one should feed [him] milk-rice mixed with honey, clarified butter, and gold.

2.11.s:
tatastvannapate rāma mantraścātra vidhīyate ..
kṛtaprāśaṃ tadotsaṅgāddhātrī bālaṃ tu vinyaset .. 107 ..
2.11.d:
ततस्त्वन्नपते राम मन्त्रश्चात्र विधीयते ॥
कृतप्राशं तदोत्सङ्गाद्धात्री बालं तु विन्यसेत् ॥ 107 ॥
2.11.m: Then, O Rāma, the mantra “To the Lord of Food…” is prescribed here. / Once he has eaten, the nurse should place the child down from her lap.

2.11.s:
devāgrato'tha vinyasya śilpabhaṇḍāni sarvaśaḥ ..
śastrāṇi caiva śāstrāṇi tataḥ paśyeta lakṣaṇam .. 105 ..
2.11.d:
देवाग्रतोऽथ विन्यस्य शिल्पभण्डानि सर्वशः ॥
शस्त्राणि चैव शास्त्राणि ततः पश्येत लक्षणम् ॥ 105 ॥
2.11.m: Having placed all kinds of tools of craftsmen, / weapons, and scriptures before the deity, one should then observe the sign:

2.11.s:
prathamaṃ yaṃ spṛśedbālaḥ śilpabhāṇḍaṃ svayaṃ tathā ..
jīvikā tasya bālasya tenaiva tu bhaviṣyati .. 109 ..
2.11.d:
प्रथमं यं स्पृशेद्बालः शिल्पभाण्डं स्वयं तथा ॥
जीविका तस्य बालस्य तेनैव तु भविष्यति ॥ 109 ॥
2.11.m: Whichever craftsman's tool the child touches first of his own accord, / by that very [profession] shall the child's livelihood be.

2.11.s:
danta janmani bālānāṃ tenaiva tu bhaviṣyati ..
dantajanmani bālānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tu nibodha me .. 2.52.110 ..
2.11.d:
दन्त जन्मनि बालानां तेनैव तु भविष्यति ॥
दन्तजन्मनि बालानां लक्षणं तु निबोध मे ॥ 2.52.110 ॥
2.11.m: [Such] will come to pass for children at the eruption of teeth; / learn from me the signs regarding the eruption of teeth in children:

2.11.s:
upari prathamaṃ yasya jāyante ca śiśordvijāḥ ..
dantairvā saha yasya syājjanma bhārgava jāyate .. 111 ..
2.11.d:
उपरि प्रथमं यस्य जायन्ते च शिशोर्द्विजाः ॥
दन्तैर्वा सह यस्य स्याज्जन्म भार्गव जायते ॥ 111 ॥
2.11.m: A child whose teeth appear first on top, / or one who is born with teeth, O Bhārgava,

2.11.s:
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ vāpi khādedātmānameva ca...
tatra śāntiṃ pravakṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu ... ..112..
2.11.d:
मातरं पितरं वापि खादेदात्मानमेव च॥।
तत्र शान्तिं प्रवक्ष्यामि तन्मे निगदतः शृणु ॥॥.112॥
2.11.m: would devour his mother, his father, or even himself. / Concerning that, I shall declare the appeasement; hear it from me as I speak:

2.11.s:
gajapṛṣṭhagataṃ bālaṃ nausthaṃ vā sthāpayeddvija ..
tadabhāve tu dharmajña kāñcane tu varāsane ..113..
2.11.d:
गजपृष्ठगतं बालं नौस्थं वा स्थापयेद्द्विज ॥
तदभावे तु धर्मज्ञ काञ्चने तु वरासने ॥113॥
2.11.m: One should place the child mounted upon an elephant's back or seated in a boat, O twice-born, / or, in the absence of that, O knower of dharma, upon an excellent golden seat.

2.11.s:
sarvauṣadhaiḥ sarvagandhairbījaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaistathā ..
pañcagavye tu ratnaiśca patākābhiśca bhārgava ..114..
2.11.d:
सर्वौषधैः सर्वगन्धैर्बीजैः पुष्पैः फलैस्तथा ॥
पञ्चगव्ये तु रत्नैश्च पताकाभिश्च भार्गव ॥114॥
2.11.m: With all medicinal herbs, all fragrant substances, seeds, flowers, and fruits, / in the five products of the cow, with jewels and banners, O Bhārgava,

2.11.s:
sthālīpākena dhātāraṃ pūjayettadanantaram ..
saptāhaṃ cātra kartavyaṃ tathā brāhmaṇabhojanam .. 115 ..
2.11.d:
स्थालीपाकेन धातारं पूजयेत्तदनन्तरम् ॥
सप्ताहं चात्र कर्तव्यं तथा ब्राह्मणभोजनम् ॥ 115 ॥
2.11.m: immediately thereafter one should worship the Creator with a cooked domestic offering. / And for seven days, the feeding of brahmins should be carried out here.

2.11.s:
aṣṭame'hani viprāṇāṃ tathā deyā ca dakṣiṇā ..
kāñcanaṃ rajataṃ gāśca bhuvaṃ cātmānameva vā .. 116 ..
2.11.d:
अष्टमेऽहनि विप्राणां तथा देया च दक्षिणा ॥
काञ्चनं रजतं गाश्च भुवं चात्मानमेव वा ॥ 116 ॥
2.11.m: On the eighth day, a dakṣiṇā should be given to the brahmins: / gold, silver, cows, land, or even oneself.

2.11.s:
dantajanmani māsānyasambhave saptamādapi ..
aṣṭame'hani viprāṇāṃ śṛṇu snānamataḥ param ..117..
2.11.d:
दन्तजन्मनि मासान्यसम्भवे सप्तमादपि ॥
अष्टमेऽहनि विप्राणां शृणु स्नानमतः परम् ॥117॥
2.11.m: If the eruption of teeth occurs in another month, even from the seventh, / hear next about the bath of the brahmins on the eighth day:

2.11.s:
bhadrāsane niveśyainaṃ mṛdbhirmūlaiḥ phalaistathā ..
sarvauṣadhaiḥ sarvagandhaiḥ sarvabījaistathaiva ca ..118..
2.11.d:
भद्रासने निवेश्यैनं मृद्भिर्मूलैः फलैस्तथा ॥
सर्वौषधैः सर्वगन्धैः सर्वबीजैस्तथैव च ॥118॥
2.11.m: Having seated him upon an auspicious seat, with earths, roots, and fruits, / with all medicinal herbs, all fragrant substances, and likewise all seeds,

2.11.s:
snāpayetpūjayeccātra vahniṃ somaṃ samīraṇam ..
pūrvataśca tathā khyātāndevadevaṃ ca keśavam ..119..
2.11.d:
स्नापयेत्पूजयेच्चात्र वह्निं सोमं समीरणम् ॥
पूर्वतश्च तथा ख्यातान्देवदेवं च केशवम् ॥119॥
2.11.m: one should bathe him and worship here Agni, Soma, and Vāyu, / and the [gods] mentioned before, as well as Keśava, the god of gods.

2.11.s:
eteṣāmeva juhuyādghṛtamagnau yathāvidhi ..
brāhmaṇānāṃ ca dātavyā tataḥ pūjā ca dakṣiṇā .. 2.52.120 ..
2.11.d:
एतेषामेव जुहुयाद्घृतमग्नौ यथाविधि ॥
ब्राह्मणानां च दातव्या ततः पूजा च दक्षिणा ॥ 2.52.120 ॥
2.11.m: To these very [gods] one should offer clarified butter into the fire according to rule, / and then worship and a dakṣiṇā must be given to the brahmins.

2.11.s:
tatastvalaṃkṛtaṃ bālaṃ cāsane tūpaveśayet ..
āsanaṃ chatramūrdhānaṃ bījaistaṃ snāpayettataḥ .. 121 ..
2.11.d:
ततस्त्वलंकृतं बालं चासने तूपवेशयेत् ॥
आसनं छत्रमूर्धानं बीजैस्तं स्नापयेत्ततः ॥ 121 ॥
2.11.m: Then one should seat the adorned child upon a seat; / one should then bathe him with seeds over his seat, umbrella, and head.

2.11.s:
susvinnairbālakānāṃ ca taiśca kāryaṃ ca pūjanam ..
pūjyāścāvidhavā nāryo brāhmaṇāḥ suhṛdastathā .. 122 ..
2.11.d:
सुस्विन्नैर्बालकानां च तैश्च कार्यं च पूजनम् ॥
पूज्याश्चाविधवा नार्यो ब्राह्मणाः सुहृदस्तथा ॥ 122 ॥
2.11.m: With [grains] well-steamed, and with those [preparations], worship of the children should be performed; / and women whose husbands are living, brahmins, and friends are to be honored.

2.11.s:
prāpte'tha pañcame varṣe tvaprasupte janārdane ..
pratipadāṃ tathā ṣaṣṭhīṃ varjayitvā tathāṣṭamīm ..123..
2.11.d:
प्राप्तेऽथ पञ्चमे वर्षे त्वप्रसुप्ते जनार्दने ॥
प्रतिपदां तथा षष्ठीं वर्जयित्वा तथाष्टमीम् ॥123॥
2.11.m: When the fifth year has arrived, while Janārdana is not asleep, / avoiding the first, sixth, and eighth lunar days,

2.11.s:
riktāṃ pañcadaśīṃ caiva saurabhaumadine tathā ..
dhuvāṇi yāmyaṃ ca tathā nakṣatrāṇi vivarjayet..124..
2.11.d:
रिक्तां पञ्चदशीं चैव सौरभौमदिने तथा ॥
धुवाणि याम्यं च तथा नक्षत्राणि विवर्जयेत्॥124॥
2.11.m: the empty [lunar day], and the fifteenth, and likewise Saturday and Tuesday, / one should completely avoid the fixed and the southern (Bharaṇī) lunar mansions.

2.11.s:
saumyavargaścare lagne hite tatra navāṃśake ..
trikoṇakendragāḥ saumyāḥ pāpāścopacaye śubhāḥ .. 125 ..
2.11.d:
सौम्यवर्गश्चरे लग्ने हिते तत्र नवांशके ॥
त्रिकोणकेन्द्रगाः सौम्याः पापाश्चोपचये शुभाः ॥ 125 ॥
2.11.m: When the division of benefics is in a moveable ascendant, and the navāṃśa is auspicious there, / benefics situated in trines and angles and malefics in upacaya [houses] are auspicious.

2.11.s:
nakṣatrāṇāṃ vivarjyānāṃ muhūrtāśca vivarjayet ..
evaṃ suniścite kāle vidyārambhaṃ ca kārayet .. 126 ..
2.11.d:
नक्षत्राणां विवर्ज्यानां मुहूर्ताश्च विवर्जयेत् ॥
एवं सुनिश्चिते काले विद्यारम्भं च कारयेत् ॥ 126 ॥
2.11.m: One should also avoid the muhūrtas of the lunar mansions that are to be avoided; / thus, at a well-determined time, one should have the commencement of education performed.

2.11.s:
pūjayitvā hariṃ lakṣmīṃ tathā devīṃ sarasvatīm ..
suvidyāṃ sūtrakārām̐śca svāṃ vidyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ .. 127 ..
2.11.d:
पूजयित्वा हरिं लक्ष्मीं तथा देवीं सरस्वतीम् ॥
सुविद्यां सूत्रकाराम्̐श्च स्वां विद्यां च विशेषतः ॥ 127 ॥
2.11.m: Having worshipped Hari, Lakṣmī, and the goddess Sarasvatī, / true learning, the authors of the sūtras, and especially one's own branch of learning,

2.11.s:
eteṣāmeva devānāṃ nāmnā tu juhuyādghṛtam ..
dakṣiṇābhirdvijendrāṇāṃ kartavyaṃ cātra pūjanam .. 128 ..
2.11.d:
एतेषामेव देवानां नाम्ना तु जुहुयाद्घृतम् ॥
दक्षिणाभिर्द्विजेन्द्राणां कर्तव्यं चात्र पूजनम् ॥ 128 ॥
2.11.m: one should offer clarified butter in the names of these very deities; / and worship of the foremost of the twice-born should be performed here with sacrificial fees.

2.11.s:
dhātryutsaṅgādathādāya bālaṃ tu kṛtavāpanam ..
svalaṃkṛtaṃ pradātavyamutsaṅge tu tadā guroḥ .. 129 ..
2.11.d:
धात्र्युत्सङ्गादथादाय बालं तु कृतवापनम् ॥
स्वलंकृतं प्रदातव्यमुत्सङ्गे तु तदा गुरोः ॥ 129 ॥
2.11.m: Then, having taken from the nurse's lap the child who has had his head shaved / and is well adorned, he should be placed into the lap of the teacher.

2.11.s:
guruścātra bhavedvidvānsnātaḥ śuklāmbaraḥ śuciḥ ..
pragṛhya taṃ tu nikṣepaṃ gururapyatha bhārgava .. 2.52.130 ..
2.11.d:
गुरुश्चात्र भवेद्विद्वान्स्नातः शुक्लाम्बरः शुचिः ॥
प्रगृह्य तं तु निक्षेपं गुरुरप्यथ भार्गव ॥ 2.52.130 ॥
2.11.m: And the teacher here should be learned, bathed, wearing white garments, and pure; / and having received that deposit, the teacher too, O Bhārgava,

2.11.s:
prāṅmukhaḥ sumukhāsīno vāruṇāśāmukhaṃ śiśum ..
adhyāpayettu prathamaṃ kuryādbālo'pi vandanam .. 131 ..
2.11.d:
प्राङ्मुखः सुमुखासीनो वारुणाशामुखं शिशुम् ॥
अध्यापयेत्तु प्रथमं कुर्याद्बालोऽपि वन्दनम् ॥ 131 ॥
2.11.m: Facing east, seated comfortably, with the child facing the western quarter, / he should teach [him] first, and the boy too should make his salutation,

2.11.s:
brāhmaṇānāṃ gurūṇāṃ ca devatānāmanantaram ..
tatastu pūjyā vittena dhātrī rāma gurustathā .. 132 ..
2.11.d:
ब्राह्मणानां गुरूणां च देवतानामनन्तरम् ॥
ततस्तु पूज्या वित्तेन धात्री राम गुरुस्तथा ॥ 132 ॥
2.11.m: first to the brahmins, gurus, and deities. / Then, O Rāma, the nurse and the guru should be honored with wealth,

2.11.s:
dakṣiṇābhirdvijendrāṇāṃ kartavyaṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathā ..
tataḥ prabhṛtyanadhyāyānvarjanīyānvivarjayet ..133 ..
2.11.d:
दक्षिणाभिर्द्विजेन्द्राणां कर्तव्यं तर्पणं तथा ॥
ततः प्रभृत्यनध्यायान्वर्जनीयान्विवर्जयेत् ॥133 ॥
2.11.m: and satisfaction must be made to the foremost twice-born with sacrificial fees. / From that time forward, he must avoid the non-study days that are to be avoided:

2.11.s:
aṣṭamīdvitayaṃ rāma pakṣānte ca dinadvayam ..
aśaucamindrayātrāṃ ca bhūkampaṃ rāhudarśanam .. 134 ..
2.11.d:
अष्टमीद्वितयं राम पक्षान्ते च दिनद्वयम् ॥
अशौचमिन्द्रयात्रां च भूकम्पं राहुदर्शनम् ॥ 134 ॥
2.11.m: the two eighth days [of the fortnights], O Rāma, and the two days at the end of each fortnight; / ritual impurity, Indra's festival, an earthquake, a solar or lunar eclipse,

2.11.s:
vyatītaṃ cāpyahorātramulkāpātaṃ ca bhārgava ..
akālastanitaṃ caiva nirjyotiṣamathāmbaram .. 135 ..
2.11.d:
व्यतीतं चाप्यहोरात्रमुल्कापातं च भार्गव ॥
अकालस्तनितं चैव निर्ज्योतिषमथाम्बरम् ॥ 135 ॥
2.11.m: a day and night when [such an event] has occurred, the fall of a meteor, O Bhārgava, / unseasonal thunder, and a sky devoid of celestial lights;

2.11.s:
tathā kāle pracaṇḍaśca yadā vāyustadā bhavet ..
pradoṣe cāpyasaṃśraddhe caityavṛkṣacatuṣpathe .. 136 ..
2.11.d:
तथा काले प्रचण्डश्च यदा वायुस्तदा भवेत् ॥
प्रदोषे चाप्यसंश्रद्धे चैत्यवृक्षचतुष्पथे ॥ 136 ॥
2.11.m: likewise when a violent wind blows at [any such] time; / at dusk, in an unfaithful place, near a sacred tree, at a crossroads,

2.11.s:
goyāne kuñjare cāśve na ca nāvi tathā bhavet ..
śvaśṛgālarave ghore tathā ca kharanisvane..137..
2.11.d:
गोयाने कुञ्जरे चाश्वे न च नावि तथा भवेत् ॥
श्वशृगालरवे घोरे तथा च खरनिस्वने॥137॥
2.11.m: in an ox-cart, on an elephant, on a horse, and not in a boat; / during the dread howl of dogs and jackals, and during the bray of a donkey;

2.11.s: tathā vāditraśabde ca tathaiva nagarotsave .. 138 ..
2.11.d: तथा वादित्रशब्दे च तथैव नगरोत्सवे ॥ 138 ॥
2.11.m: likewise during the sound of musical instruments, and similarly during a festival in the town.

2.11.s:
kāleṣu deśeṣu mayoditeṣu paṭhanti ye nāma na teṣu vidyā ..
phalaṃ prayacchetyathavā'riśatrorloke pare vā yadi vā'pi cāsmin .. 139 ..
iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne bālatantro nāma dvipañcāśattamo
'dhyāyaḥ..52..
2.53
śrīparaśurāma uvāca ..
putrīyaṃ bhagavansnānaṃ putrīyamatha saptamīm ..
putrīyaṃ ca samācakṣva tathā vai keśavavratam..1..
puṣkara uvāca ..
upoṣitau kṛttikāsu yajamānapurohitau ..
rohiṇyāṃ snapanaṃ kuryuryajamānasya bhārgava .. 2 ..
kṣīravṛkṣaprarohābhyāṃ sitamālyavibhūṣitam..
priyaṅgucandanopetānpañca kumbhānprapūjayet .. 3 ..
prāṅmukhaṃ vrīhirāśisthaṃ kumbhaistairabhiṣecayet ..
viṣṇuṃ śaśāṅkaṃ varuṇaṃ rohiṇīṃ ca prajāpatim .. 4 ..
pūjayetprayataḥ śraddhī gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ ..
dhūpaḥ prajāpaterdeyastathaiva śaṭakeśayāḥ ..5..
2.11.d:
कालेषु देशेषु मयोदितेषु पठन्ति ये नाम न तेषु विद्या ॥
फलं प्रयच्छेत्यथवाऽरिशत्रोर्लोके परे वा यदि वाऽपि चास्मिन् ॥ 139 ॥
इति श्रीविष्णुधर्मोत्तरे द्वितीयखण्डे मा0 सं0 रामं प्रति पुष्करोपाख्याने बालतन्त्रो नाम द्विपञ्चाशत्तमो
ऽध्यायः॥52॥
2.53
श्रीपरशुराम उवाच ॥
पुत्रीयं भगवन्स्नानं पुत्रीयमथ सप्तमीम् ॥
पुत्रीयं च समाचक्ष्व तथा वै केशवव्रतम्॥1॥
पुष्कर उवाच ॥
उपोषितौ कृत्तिकासु यजमानपुरोहितौ ॥
रोहिण्यां स्नपनं कुर्युर्यजमानस्य भार्गव ॥ 2 ॥
क्षीरवृक्षप्ररोहाभ्यां सितमाल्यविभूषितम्॥
प्रियङ्गुचन्दनोपेतान्पञ्च कुम्भान्प्रपूजयेत् ॥ 3 ॥
प्राङ्मुखं व्रीहिराशिस्थं कुम्भैस्तैरभिषेचयेत् ॥
विष्णुं शशाङ्कं वरुणं रोहिणीं च प्रजापतिम् ॥ 4 ॥
पूजयेत्प्रयतः श्रद्धी गन्धमाल्यानुलेपनैः ॥
धूपः प्रजापतेर्देयस्तथैव शटकेशयाः ॥5॥
2.11.m:
Indeed, those who recite in the times and places mentioned by me—their learning / does not yield fruit, or it goes to the enemy, whether in the other world or even in this one.
Thus ends the fifty-second chapter, entitled 'Rules for Children,' in the second book of the illustrious Viṣṇudharmottara, in the dialogue between Mārkaṇḍeya and Vajra, in the narrative of Puṣkara to Rāma.
2.53 / The illustrious Paraśurāma said: / O venerable one, describe the son-bestowing bath, and the son-bestowing Seventh [Tithi], / and also the son-bestowing Keśava observance.
Puṣkara said: / Having both fasted on the Kṛttikās, the patron and the family priest, / O Bhārgava, should perform the patron's bath on the Rohiṇī [nakṣatra].
He should worship five water jars adorned with white garlands and with sprouts of milky trees, / furnished with priyaṅgu and sandalwood.
He should consecrate him, seated facing east upon a heap of paddy, with those jars. / To Viṣṇu, the Moon, Varuṇa, Rohiṇī, and Prajāpati
he should offer worship with devotion and self-restraint, with perfumes, garlands, and ointments. / Incense must be offered to Prajāpati, as well as a mattress of grass;

2.11.s:
pañcapṛṣṭhavṛṣāndigdhāndadhnā ca vinivedayet ..
prajādhyakṣāya homañca devatānāṃ tu kārayet ..6..
ghṛtena sarvabījaiśca śuklavāsā jitendriyaḥ ..
dakṣiṇāṃ gurave deyātkāmyaṃ gaurvāsasī śubhe .. 7 ..
suvarṇaṃ ca mahābhāga viprāṇāmatha śaktitaḥ ..
śuklā ca gaurvṛṣaḥ śuklastayorloma śaphaṃ tathā ..8..
śṛṅgāṇi trivṛtaṃ kṛtvā maṇirdhāryastato bhavet ..9..
alaṃkṛtaṃ keśamidaṃ sadaiva snānaṃ tu kurvanpuruṣo'thavā strī ..
putrānavāpnoti tatheṣṭatāṃ ca puṣṭiṃ tathāgryāṃ vipulāṃ ca kīrtim.. 2.53.10 ..
2.54
.. puṣkara uvāca ..
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi śuklapakṣe dvijottama ..
putrīyāṃ saptamīṃ rāma gṛhṇīyātprayataḥ śuciḥ .. 1 ..
athavā putrakāmā strī vidhinā yena tacchṛṇu ..
haviṣyāśī śiraḥsnātaḥ kṛtvā brāhmaṇapūjanam .. 2 ..
2.11.d:
पञ्चपृष्ठवृषान्दिग्धान्दध्ना च विनिवेदयेत् ॥
प्रजाध्यक्षाय होमञ्च देवतानां तु कारयेत् ॥6॥
घृतेन सर्वबीजैश्च शुक्लवासा जितेन्द्रियः ॥
दक्षिणां गुरवे देयात्काम्यं गौर्वाससी शुभे ॥ 7 ॥
सुवर्णं च महाभाग विप्राणामथ शक्तितः ॥
शुक्ला च गौर्वृषः शुक्लस्तयोर्लोम शफं तथा ॥8॥
शृङ्गाणि त्रिवृतं कृत्वा मणिर्धार्यस्ततो भवेत् ॥9॥
अलंकृतं केशमिदं सदैव स्नानं तु कुर्वन्पुरुषोऽथवा स्त्री ॥
पुत्रानवाप्नोति तथेष्टतां च पुष्टिं तथाग्र्यां विपुलां च कीर्तिम्॥ 2.53.10 ॥

॥ पुष्कर उवाच ॥
मार्गशीर्षे शुभे मासि शुक्लपक्षे द्विजोत्तम ॥
पुत्रीयां सप्तमीं राम गृह्णीयात्प्रयतः शुचिः ॥ 1 ॥
अथवा पुत्रकामा स्त्री विधिना येन तच्छृणु ॥
हविष्याशी शिरःस्नातः कृत्वा ब्राह्मणपूजनम् ॥ 2 ॥
2.11.m:
and one should offer five bulls smeared on their backs with curds. / He should have an oblation offered to the Lord of Creatures and to the deities,
with ghee and with all seeds, dressed in white, with senses subdued. / He should give a sacrificial fee to the guru: a desirable cow and two auspicious garments,
and gold to the brahmins, O highly fortunate one, according to his capacity. / A white cow and a white bull—their hair, hooves,
and horns having been threefold bound, an amulet must then be worn.
A man or woman who always performs this bath with hair adorned / obtains sons, desirable things, supreme nourishment, and extensive fame.
2.54 / Puṣkara said: / In the auspicious month of Mārgaśīrṣa, in the bright fortnight, O foremost of the twice-born, / O Rāma, he should undertake the son-bestowing Seventh [Tithi], self-restrained and pure.
Or a woman desiring a son [may do so]. Hear according to which rite: / Eating sacrificial food, having washed the head, and having performed the worship of brahmins,
